description: MEMET RIDING MEMET INTO MEMETNESS!

description: By the light of the North Star, you battle your way through an almost-infinite horde of foes. But as long as you stay true and keep to the course you've set, you'll reach the eternal glory you seek.

name: Astral Celestial Wings
description: As the Astral Celestial unfurls their wings, they become the light of the night sky. Their brethren send them away with wishes, believing that they'll return to their creator.

description: (Item does 20% more damage to all tagged monsters when equipped.)For Nulgath and Nation! The ArchFiend Deathlords are superior human DeathKnights of the Nulgath Nation who lead Void Highlords to battle!

name: DeathLord Cloak of Nulgath
description: (Item does 20% more damage to all tagged monsters when equipped.)Nulgath rewards his most loyal followers the best stuff.

name: DeathLord Malifact Cape
description: It's impossible to ascertain who the first of the DeathSworn were, or if they were called this to begin with. Relics are passed from one Knight to another in the ruins of forgotten nations.

name: DeathLord Spines of Nulgath
description: (Item does 20% more damage to all tagged monsters when equipped.)For Nulgath and Nation! The ArchFiend Deathlords are superior human DeathKnights of the Nulgath Nation who lead Void Highlords to battle!

name: Deathly Dragonblood Shroud
description: The self-proclaimed DragonPlane Guardians are shunned by true Dragons. These long-lived beasts abhor the idea of death, for whenever it touches their scales, ghastly necromancers gather like maggots to enslave them.

name: Deathly Naval Cape (AC)
description: Here's a secret. The Horseman of Death can't swim. Having this billowing cape isn't going to help. You can evade Death by shoving him overboard. He didn't speak to me for fifty years after pulling that stunt. Made spreading plagues a lot harder.

name: Deathly Naval Cape (Non-AC)
description: Here's a secret. The Horseman of Death can't swim. Having this billowing cape isn't going to help. You can evade Death by shoving him overboard. He didn't speak to me for fifty years after pulling that stunt. Made spreading plagues a lot harder.

name: Deathly Prophecy Altar (0 AC)
description: A monument to the land of the dead, and to the impending death of the stars. Drenching it in blood causes the fabled day when the Black Sun swallows the universe to get closer. (Click to activate)

name: Deathly Prophecy Altar (AC)
description: A monument to the land of the dead, and to the impending death of the stars. Drenching it in blood causes the fabled day when the Black Sun swallows the universe to get closer. (Click to activate)

name: Deathly Scholar's Cloak
description: A collective of scholars gathered in the Underworld, holding a symposium that will last eternity. The living risk death to seek their knowledge, but few are able to return. Sometimes they get stuck in discussions, letting decades slip past.

name: Deathly Underworld Spikes (AC)
description: These spikes are…actually pretty itchy and throw your balance off. It's the Evil standard, so you'll look bald without them.

name: Deathly Underworld Spikes (Non-AC)
description: These spikes are…actually pretty itchy and throw your balance off. It's the Evil standard, so you'll look bald without them.

name: DeathRider Skull (Cape)
description: Ever get the feeling you're being watched? No never? Me neither.

name: DeathSworn Cape
description: The DeathSworn arm themselves with relics and spells that require a sacrifice of life in exchange for deadly power. While it's easier to offer the lives of others, relinquishing one's own lifeforce yields far more effective results.

name: Deathwalker Fall (0 AC)
description: There is no force greater than death. Use it to dominate your enemies.

name: Deathwalker Fall (AC)
description: There is no force greater than death. Use it to dominate your enemies.

name: Deathwalker Fates (0 AC)
description: There is no force greater than death. Use it to dominate your enemies.

name: Deathwalker Fates (AC)
description: There is no force greater than death. Use it to dominate your enemies.

name: Deathwalker Sheathed Blades (AC)
description: There is no force greater than death. Use it to dominate your enemies.

name: Deathwalker Sheathed Blades (Non-AC)
description: There is no force greater than death. Use it to dominate your enemies.

name: Deathwing Rune (0 AC)
description: A mysterious sigil can only be seen in complete darkness. They aren't a new hope, but they could be a way out. Reach for its faint light, and find rest.

name: Deathwing Rune (AC)
description: A mysterious sigil can only be seen in complete darkness. They aren't a new hope, but they could be a way out. Reach for its faint light, and find rest.

name: Debris 297 BackBlade
description: Do you know what true emptiness is? There is no light. Not even a space for the darkness to fill the sun's absence. Will you trust in fate, or take control of your own destiny? The choice is yours.

name: Debris Death Guardian
description: Those who see the original masters of the Debris Note see them as guardians from above. The source of the Debris is kind in nature, so maybe that notion isn't as delusional as you'd think.

name: Debris Note Creature
description: The original masters of the Debris Note have peculiar tastes. Were tomatoes their favorite food. It certainly isn't bananas.

name: Debris Vestiges
description: Ripped off of a creature only Darkon could identify, this cape will terrify your opponents and impress all the heroes in Yulgar's Inn.

name: Deck And Mantle
description: How do you making a house of cards when your entire deck is floating behind you? You don't. They're just there to help you look pretty… and that long cape thing too I guess.

name: Deck Of Hearts
description: How do you making a house of cards when your entire deck is floating behind you? You don't. They're just there to help you look pretty…

name: DeckMaster's Crossed Blades
description: Carry out the Captain's order or they be havin' you walk the plank!

name: DeckMaster's Wrap
description: Carry out the Captain's Order or they be havin' you walk the plank!

name: Deep Fried Turkey Wings
description: That turkey should have flew away before falling in the deep fryer.

name: Deep Twilight Victory Laurel (0 AC)
description: Only the most skilled of the Celestial Realm's Guardians ascend to the ranks of the High Celestial Protectors. It is one of the realm's highest honors.

name: Deep Twilight Victory Laurel (AC)
description: Only the most skilled of the Celestial Realm's Guardians ascend to the ranks of the High Celestial Protectors. It is one of the realm's highest honors.

name: Deep Void Marauder Tail
description: You can fall into the Void on a walk, or roll into it when you get out of bed. It's an unknowable space between the folds of space. Once you're trapped, you'll never return to the way you used to be.

name: DeepSea Star Pirate's Wings
description: DeepSea Star Pirates study the creatures found only in the brightest seas and the darkest of abyssal waters. They vow to use their power to protect all of the creatures that make the trenches their home.

name: DeepWater Corona
description: ﻿A glowing corona made of bioluminescent matter rather than precious metal. The light attracts massive sea monsters, leading them to their doom at the hands of a single relentless Drow.

name: DeepWater Waves
description: The depths of the sea trap darkness and there is no escape. Anything could be lurking in the murk, whether willingly or not. Some imagine that this is the nature of Neso, hiding the ugliest parts of her character in shadows.

name: Defender's Runed Wings
description: No one can actually "fly" in space without the nebular wings to keep its user in control of their movement.

name: Defenders of Balemorale Spikes
description: Lord Granville and his Knights bravely fought for King Alteon during the Rebellion, and have been waiting for a chance to fight some real Evil again ever since.

name: Delinquent Leader's Sash
description: There are many who choose to defy the rules of the Crystallis administration. These citizens roam the streets, breaking curfews and windows. They will soon be… re-educated.

name: Delinquent's Starlit Wings
description: There are many who choose to defy the rules of the Crystallis administration. These citizens roam the streets, breaking curfews and windows. They will soon be… re-educated.

name: Delinquent's Twilit Wings (0 AC)
description: There are many who choose to defy the rules of the Crystallis administration. These citizens roam the streets, breaking curfews and windows. They will soon be… re-educated.

name: Delinquent's Twilit Wings (AC)
description: There are many who choose to defy the rules of the Crystallis administration. These citizens roam the streets, breaking curfews and windows. They will soon be… re-educated.

name: Demigod's Divine Scathanna
description: The Shadows of Skye that were meant to protect the people who called it home are being used as a glamorous shawl. Bananach's hands reach out, seeking aid.

name: Demigod's Scathanna
description: The Shadows of Skye that were meant to protect the people who called it home are being used as a glamorous shawl. Bananach's hands reach out, seeking aid.

name: Demigod's Shadow Veil
description: The Shadows of Skye that were meant to protect the people who called it home are being used as a glamorous shawl. Bananach's hands reach out, seeking aid.

name: Demolicious' Ball Cape
description: A unique tool for popping tires, locking gears, and impeding wheel spokes.

name: Demonic Nemesis Cape
description: Some necromancer must just have wired bone to bone to create his intimidating bonewing cape! Designed by Ninjudo.

name: Denmark Pride Scarf
description: /Cheer for your country's olympic athletes! Good luck to everyone competing!

name: Denmark Spirit Cape
description: Show your World Cup Spirit!

name: Denmark Spirit Scarf
description: Wear the official colors of your country proudly. Battle on!

name: Derp Leeches of Nulgath
description: Something has happened to these blood sucking parasites, who love to latch onto your latest victim for a nice mid-afternoon snack.

name: Derp or Flight
description: Your only options used to be being flayed by fear or fleeing in terror. Fear is not longer an option… laughing at them until you fall over is.

name: Derpy Pink Back Moglin
description: This derpy moglin always has your back. Because she's always attached to your back. Best friends forever yippee!

name: Derpy White Wings
description: Derps of feather hurrrp together.

name: Desert Apocalypse Wings
description: Polycrystalline silicon wings, welded with state-of-the-art tech to survive the rays of a dying sun.

name: Desert Hound Reserve Tank
description: Highly explosive and temperature-sensitive. You either survive, or go out with a bang.

name: Destiny Cloak
description: Your back will always be protected when you have this pure-white and gold-embellished cape Equipped! No arrows of misfortune nor axes of evil intent will be able to penetrate it!.

name: Devious Leather Wings and Tail
description: Be fun! Commit crimes! The only thing stopping you is yourself! And the law, but we'll cross that bridge when we get to it.

name: Devoid Techcannon
description: Magitechnology is forbidden to be used as a weapon, but for better or for worse, there will always be those who ignore this law.

name: Devoured Diabolical Sigil
description: Overtaken by nature, this sigil of the Diabolicals is one with the otherworld. Be careful - the vines are a little prickly.

name: Devourer of Souls Cape (0 AC)
description: Not all souls captured for the Legion go to Dage. Some of his most fiercest warriors consume souls in an effort to gain more power.

name: Devourer of Souls Cape (AC)
description: Not all souls captured for the Legion go to Dage. Some of his most fiercest warriors consume souls in an effort to gain more power.

name: Devourer of Souls Horned Cape (0 AC)
description: Not all souls captured for the Legion go to Dage. Some of his most fiercest warriors consume souls in an effort to gain more power.

name: Devourer of Souls Horned Cape (AC)
description: Not all souls captured for the Legion go to Dage. Some of his most fiercest warriors consume souls in an effort to gain more power.

name: Devouring Legion Rune
description: As your focus sharpens, so too do the spines of this Legion rune.

name: Dew Dancer Wings
description: These wings are similiar to those of the fairies that dwell in the groves of DragonFable and flit through the soft light, shining through the tress in the early morning.

name: Diabolical Admiral's Cloak
description: Travelling the dark seas requires you to not only take charge of your crew but to prove your worth. Only the most dedicated of the Diabolical fleet are granted the title of Admiral — wear it with pride.

name: Diabolical Appendages and Tail
description: Grounded, but indomitable. These heavy vestiges keep the Gargoyle from reaching the sky, but make them a dangerous foe. Even the most seasoned of warriors get crushed and minced into paste.

name: Diabolical Cloak + Arms
description: Travelling the dark seas requires you to not only take charge of your crew but to prove your worth. Only the most dedicated of the Diabolical fleet are granted the title of Admiral — wear it with pride.

name: Diabolical Cloak + Tide
description: Travelling the dark seas requires you to not only take charge of your crew but to prove your worth. Only the most dedicated of the Diabolical fleet are granted the title of Admiral — wear it with pride.

name: Diabolical Ectoplasm Spirit
description: Made out of the ectoplasm they control, this loyal spirit of the Diabolical Ectomancers appears to be menacing. The origin of the first Ectoplasm Spirit is not known.

name: Diabolical Edge Cape
description: The icon of the Diabolical Ectomancers, this has taken form from the ectoplasm they work with and shows their membership in this elite group.

name: Diabolical Fur Wrap
description: The nights are dark and cold. Hunters skin fallen beasts on the spot to make cloaks that'll keep them warm. (CC to Trim)

name: Diabolical Gargoyle's Appendages
description: Concerning flight, these wings are purely vestigial appendages. They're mainly used for lacerating their prey, and anything that had the misfortune of getting in the way.

name: Diabolical Gargoyle Tail
description: The tail of a great Gargoyle. One languid swing could shatter a whole suit of armor. How they're able to move so quickly with such a heavy load garners scholarly curiosity.

name: Diabolical Guitar on your back
description: Blast the tunes and have your listeners fall into a trance, but perhaps smashing it on stage is a bit overdone, you should smash it against your foes.

name: Diabolical Jet Turbines
description: Not quite a jetpack, but it'll get you there just as fast, if not faster… maybe a bit too fast, really. Just be careful to not burn yourself up!

name: Diabolical Magi Sigil
description: Shattered and never-ending, this broken summoning circle will have unpredictable and unstable effects on incantations, use at your own risk.

name: Diabolical Monk's Cloak
description: A ripped cloak, torn apart from hundreds of spiritual journey trips, as mangled as it may seem, it's shown your effort towards your mastery.

name: Diabolical Monk's Scroll
description: Some say knowledge is power, and it may be true, but knowledge is also heavy with such a large scroll. Carry the dark arts on your back with honor and some pain.

name: Diabolical Ornate Shrine
description: A divine shroud of metal only used by the Diabolical higher court members, this elaborate shrine is used as a status symbol of power.

name: Diabolical Otherworldly Rift
description: Always watching and reaching out, this cosmic horror from the otherworldly plane is constantly seeking to makee you its next vessel.

name: Diabolical Otherworldy Arms
description: There always seems to be a need for more arms to do things, with some sacrifice, the eldritch parasites have given you a "gift" of more limbs, use them with hesitance.

name: Diabolical Planetoids
description: The molten cores of these planetoids are exploited to power forbidden pyromancies. They are shackled to the gravitational ley lines of Lore.

name: Diabolical Prophetic Shrine
description: An ornate shrine containing the aura of the divine, its light will guide you along the way and perhaps even foretell the future.

name: Diabolical Shadowhunter Muffler
description: Whiles it doesn't provide much warmth, the tattered silk is laden with sweet memories. It makes hunting in the dark just a little more bearable.

name: Diabolical Summer Bag
description: ﻿﻿﻿Something every adventurer needs for their journey is a reliable bag to hold their equipment. This should serve you perfectly and make you look stylish at the same time.

name: Diabolical Summer Lanterns
description: Even occultists attend the summer festival, these stylized lanterns light up your path, and perhaps your fate.

name: Diabolical Summoning Circle
description: These demented runes are constantly calling your name, whispering to you, wishing to be let free of the rift in which they are sealed in.

name: Diabolical Thruster Wings
description: These extremely lightweight wings will help you cover great amounts of land fast and make sure you charge them or else you might have an early landing!

name: Diabolical Tide
description: Travelling the dark seas requires you to not only take charge of your crew but to prove your worth. Only the most dedicated of the Diabolical fleet are granted the title of Admiral — wear it with pride.

name: Diabolical Tome Cape
description: Imbued by the dark magic of the Diabolical Illusionists, this tome will follow you wherever you go, no matter how far into the darkness you journey.

name: Diabolical Umbrella Cape
description: Cult members probably don't like the sun with all the meetings in the dark, take this parasol with you and keep yourself in the shade!

name: Diabolical Void Knight Wings
description: Thin, fragile wings that can keep their wearer in midair for longer distances than a dragon of darkness. This item gives 25% more XP and Class Points when equipped.

name: Diabolical Warden's Captive
description: Forever bound to their warden, these eldritch horrors are held prisoner and turned against their own kind for the rest of their lives, with only the death of the warden allowing them to depart.

name: Diabolical Witch Cat
description: An adorable furball coming from the Diabolical courtrooms, perhaps this cute furball came from the broken woods?

name: Diabolical Witch Cloak
description: The wrap of the Diabolical witch, while short, this black shroud will keep its user quite warm.

name: Diabolical Witch Cloak + Cat
description: An adorable furball coming from the Diabolical courtrooms, perhaps this cute furball came from the broken woods? They tag along with you while you wear your wrap.

name: Diabolical Wyvern Wings
description: Illusions are key for you, and looking frightening is the goal. When trying to make your foe intimidated, these wings may appear real, however are just a clever construction, don't try to lift off with them.

name: Diamond Collector Cape (AC)
description: Nulgath cuts his diamonds extremely sharp. They regularly tear into cloth, and even armor and flesh.

name: Diamond Collector Cape (Non-AC)
description: Nulgath cuts his diamonds extremely sharp. They regularly tear into cloth, and even armor and flesh.

name: Diamond Moonlight
description: It's like you plucked the silver moon and diamond stars right out of the sky. They're not the real deal, but dreams are more beautiful than reality.

name: Diffraction Rays
description: As light travels through the void between the folding fabric of space, catching on the edges of new worlds, it fractures into new forms. If someone were to go through the same process…

name: Digital Countdown Clock
description: Able to manipulate multiple simultaneous events with ease, the Polychronic Magister glides through space and time, compelling all they meet.

name: Digital Dragon Guard
description: These DragonSlayers only work on behalf of the ShadowScythe. If the dragon won't agree to burn on behalf of Empress Gravelyn, they must go!

name: Diplomatic Mantle
description: A heavy cloak to protect against strong winds, cold winters, and purple tentacles.

name: Dire Marrowspikes
description: The bones shooting of your back might be a useful club to fend monsters. It'll grow back, probably.

name: Disco Crystal (0 AC)
description: It's a party everywhere you go! Also works as a conduit to shoot magic beams.

name: Disco Crystal (AC)
description: It's a party everywhere you go! Also works as a conduit to shoot magic beams.

name: Disguised Pirate's Crossed Cutlasses
description: Forged to resemble the storm weathered look of a pirate's blade, the craftsmanship makes it the envy of swashbucklers from every corner of the sea.

name: Dissonant Aura
description: Dissonance and noise, shouts and roars, they are the music of nature untouched by mortal kind.

name: Dissonant Harp Wings
description: Harps taken from Mythsong and Swordhaven sprouted possessive purple tentacles when they were corrupted by Chaos. Though their songs are meant to sow madness, their songs are jealously coveted by the Chaotic minions that share the same temperment as their Champion.

name: Divine Champion's Mantle
description: ﻿The bright power emanating from this mantle soothes your spirit and renews your flagging energy. It is a testament to your many victories in the Infernal Arena.

name: Divine Deathwings (0 AC)
description: The wings and halo can only be seen in complete darkness. They aren't a new hope, but they could be a way out. Reach for their faint light, and find rest.

name: Divine Deathwings (AC)
description: The wings and halo can only be seen in complete darkness. They aren't a new hope, but they could be a way out. Reach for their faint light, and find rest.

name: Divine Eyes of Scathanna
description: In the Demigod's stolen Shadows are the eyes of the divine. One was opened when a creation was reborn, and the other was a memento from his creator.

name: Divine Gate of the Stern Lord (AC)
description: The Lord Justices of the ArchAngel used to be mortal. They draw their power from Nulgath himself, earning the ability to fly with their good deeds.

name: Divine Gate of the Stern Lord (Non-AC)
description: The Lord Justices of the ArchAngel used to be mortal. They draw their power from Nulgath himself, earning the ability to fly with their good deeds.

name: Divine Guardian Wings
description: Elite wardens of the Celestial Realm, these bright warriors willingly give their lives to defend their people their people and home. Aegis Guardians must pass a rigorous battery of tests to be allowed entry into this exclusive group.

name: Divine Ox Carrying Pole
description: It is said the strongest heroes are as strong as an ox… and with this carrying pole, you can prove them right!

name: Divine Tundra Warlock Cape (AC)
description: Made from rare silk spun from worms that devour what little vegetation grows in the frigid north. Those that prove their might were awarded these capes by Ice Elf clans…so long as you were one of them.

name: Divine Tundra Warlock Cape (Non-AC)
description: Made from rare silk spun from worms that devour what little vegetation grows in the frigid north. Those that prove their might were awarded these capes by Ice Elf clans…so long as you were one of them.

name: Divine Wanderer's Guidance
description: ﻿The bright power emanating from these wings soothes your spirit and renews your flagging energy. It is a testament to your many victories in the Infernal Arena.

name: Djinn Knight's Aura
description: Power and magic… Djinn Knights must possess both if they are to successfully guard the denizens of the Djinn Realm.

name: Djinn Lich's Legs
description: Little is known about Zelkur, Lich of the Dream Palace… except that the ShadowHunter desires the Mystic Sapphire he possesses. Rumor has it that the gem contains the essence of his power.

name: Djinn Realm Aura
description: One can call on a Djinn's power if they are summoned and negotiated with. Knowledge and protection are popular wishes, and an aura like this will show others what you've accomplished. (Color-customizable to Accessory)

name: Djinn Warrior Blade + Sack
description: These guardians of the realm serve the Djinn, so they must always present a noble and austere appearance.

name: Djinn Warrior Sack
description: These guardians of the realm serve the Djinn, so they must always present a noble and austere appearance.

name: Dominators Touch
description: DOMINATION

name: Dominica Pride Scarf
description: /Cheer for your country's olympic athletes! Good luck to everyone competing!

name: Dominica Spirit Scarf
description: Wear the official colors of your country proudly. Battle on!

name: Dominican Republic Pride Scarf
description: /Cheer for your country's olympic athletes! Good luck to everyone competing!

name: Dominican Republic Spirit Scarf
description: Wear the official colors of your country proudly. Battle on!

name: Dominion of Light Ascension
description: The greater the deeds of the righteous who fight alongside the Archangel Nulgath, the higher they ascend. Some souls radiate with light from birth.

name: Dominion of Light Aura
description: The greater the deeds of the righteous who fight alongside the Archangel Nulgath, the higher they ascend. Some souls radiate with light from birth.

name: Dominion of Light Wings
description: The greater the deeds of the righteous who fight alongside the Archangel Nulgath, the higher they ascend. Wings are just the start.

name: Dominion of the Void Horns (0 AC)
description: These horns inspire primal fear in Fiends of all eras. They symbolize a return to one's origins, and the breaking of pride. Beneath every Fiend is a lowly mortal that had the audacity to think they were more.

name: Dominion of the Void Horns (AC)
description: These horns inspire primal fear in Fiends of all eras. They symbolize a return to one's origins, and the breaking of pride. Beneath every Fiend is a lowly mortal that had the audacity to think they were more.

name: Doom Banner
description: A banner with the image of a Doomknight's helm on it. Strap this to your back so you may be recognized on the battlefield.

name: Doom Celestial Sandwings
description: With these wings, it is almost as if you could take flight, soaring over the vast expanses of the wide-open Sandsea!

name: Doom Clawsuit BackBlades
description: There's no need to check the list twice when those who are naughty and nice are suffering in the shadows all at once. DOOM for Frostval has arrived!

name: Doom Cloak
description: The style of cloak worn by Doom Knights--the elite soldiers of the Shadowscythe Army!

name: Doom DragonSlayer's Winged Wrap
description: These DragonSlayers work only on behalft of the ShadowScythe. If the draagon won't agree to burn behalf of Empress Gravelyn, they must go!

name: Doom DragonSlayer's Wings
description: These DragonSlayers only work on behalf of the ShadowScythe. If the dragon won't agree to burn on behalf of Empress Gravelyn, they must go!

name: Doom DragonSlayer's Wrap
description: These DragonSlayers work only on behalft of the ShadowScythe. If the draagon won't agree to burn behalf of Empress Gravelyn, they must go!

name: Doom Fiend Wings (0 AC)
description: Wrested from the Shadows, these creatures now serve the Archfiend Nulgath. Veins and muscle grew where the Shadows once gnawed, birthing new malicious power.

name: Doom Fiend Wings (AC)
description: Wrested from the Shadows, these creatures now serve the Archfiend Nulgath. Veins and muscle grew where the Shadows once gnawed, birthing new malicious power.

name: Doom Frozen Tentacles
description: That's a n-ICE cape you've got there! Lookin' REAL sharp!

name: Doom Lord Skulled Cape
description: The hard work of over 50 individuals went into crafting this masterpiece of a mantle. Took bad the hard work was well…dying.

name: Doom Lord Valtrith Cape
description: A hollowed chill comes from such a cloak of strange and eerie darkness. Who knows what malicious spirits lurk deep inside? Do you want to find out?

name: Doom Lord Vordred Cape
description: The hard work of over 50 individuals went into crafting this masterpiece of a mantle. Took bad the hard work was well…dying.

name: Doom Lycan Wings
description: A pair of giant wings plucked off the Chaos Lord Wolfwing a Chaos creature! He won't be needing these anymore…

name: Doom Painbow Cape
description: You definitely won't find gold at the end of this painbow.

name: Doom Rocket Pack
description: This should get you there faster…

name: Doom Spider Legs
description: Six creepy spider legs sprout from your back. You look terrifying. (color custom)

name: Doom Wings of Ishtar
description: Majestic multi-colored wings sprout from your back. Take flight as an avatar of war and bring defeat and shame to you enemies.

name: Doom Worm Creepers
description: Two disturbing (skull-headed) Doom Worms burst from your back wriggling in the air.

name: Doom Worshipper's Cape
description: Sepulchure's hold is strong. These warriors follow the shadows and support their Lord.

name: Doom Worshipper's Wrap
description: Sepulchure's hold is strong. These warriors follow the shadows and support their Lord.

name: Doom Worshipper Wrap + Blade
description: Sepulchure's hold is strong. These warriors follow the shadows and support their Lord.

name: Doom Wyrm Wings +5
description: Gives +5% boost to reputation earned and +3% boost to gold drops.

name: DoomCaster Sigil Tails
description: The pulsing energy coursing through this sash is the courage and bravery that a Doom Caster's adversary lost after an unfortunate encounter. Its victim's fate remains unknown to this day, but the colors allow the sash to stay safe in style for almost three centuries. Suggested by player Lilith

name: DoomDragon's Runes
description: Take to the skies in fiendish style. Only ones who are direct descendants of the DoomDragon Mother can tame these legendary beasts.

name: DoomDragon's Winged Runes
description: Take to the skies in fiendish style. Only ones who are direct descendants of the DoomDragon Mother can tame these legendary beasts.

name: DoomDragon's Wings
description: Take to the skies in fiendish style. Only ones who are direct descendants of the DoomDragon Mother can tame these legendary beasts.

name: Doomed Artillery Array
description: The disembodied heads of a terrifying Shadowscythe Hydra are at the command of the Empire's marksmen. Only one is allowed to be active during a battle, lest casualties mount on the wrong side.

name: Doomed DeathSworn Cape
description: The DeathSworn arm themselves with relics and spells that require a sacrifice of life in exchange for deadly power. While it's easier to offer the lives of others, relinquishing one's own lifeforce yields far more effective results.

name: DOOMED Monster Lord Cape
description: Only the bravest heroes who have battled and defeated all of Lore's many monsters may called themselves true Monster Lords.

name: DOOMED Monster Lord Dragon
description: Only the bravest heroes who have battled and defeated all of Lore's many monsters may called themselves true Monster Lords.

name: DOOMED Monster Lord Dragon Cape
description: Only the bravest heroes who have battled and defeated all of Lore's many monsters may called themselves true Monster Lords.

name: Doomed Runes
description: Found in one of the refuse heaps in Dreadrock, these runes will start glowing as soon as you put them on. AAAAH. GET IT OFFFF!

name: Doomed Stalker's BackBlade
description: Once simple pirates these now cursed souls sail the darkest deeps of the seas looking for souls to harvest.

name: DoomFiend Overlord's Cloak (AC)

name: High ShadowScythe Rogue's Cape
description: Adding the Deadtech Node seems to have removed all color from this item. How strange.

name: High ShadowScythe Trooper's Cape

name: High Shield of the Clerics
description: This banner serves to remind all that a) you are a ChaosWeaver Cleric, or b) you have defeated one in combat!

name: High Witch's Wings
description: Some signs of witchcraft at work are more obvious than others. Then again, the vampires might mistake you for one of their own.

name: Highborn Cloak
description: Cape of the Highborn.

name: Highborn Necromancer Cape
description: Defectors of courtly decadence that preferred a darker calling. They took their riches, class, and decorated history with them. Death will not excuse their retainers from service.

name: Highlord's Void Wrap
description: This cape is made out of a rare material found in the Void. It takes those with a strong will and resistance to the darkness that surrounds this cape in order to wear it.

name: Hikari no Akuma Guardian
description: Do not let the name fool you. They may be driven by the light but these Akuma still have deep dark powers.

name: Himawari Kitsune Ninetails
description: The Kitsune believe the the Great Yokai spirit was a ninetailed fox. Himawari aimed to shine as bright as her creator, but keeps losing them in stupid ways. That's what happens when you girlboss too close to the sun.

name: Himawari Kitsune Tails
description: It takes a century for a Kitsune to grow a new tail. For Himawari, it took two centuries of worth of sunny days. She's not very active when it rains.

name: Hoisted Necrostar Scythe
description: The musically talented have a habit of leaving the world of the living young. Perhaps their music was so alluring that the realm of the dead couldn't resist.

name: Hoisted Seraphic Flag (AC)
description: Mark territory with the symbol of the Seraphic Paladins. The undead will never rise from this land.

name: Hoisted Seraphic Flag (Non-AC)
description: Mark territory with the symbol of the Seraphic Paladins. The undead will never rise from this land.

name: Holiday ArchPaladin Cape
description: Artix the UndeadSlaying Paladin is getting into the Frostval Spirit, and the BEST way he can do is free any last spirits trapped inside Vordred the Paladin Slayer.

name: Holiday Courier Cape (0 AC)
description: A stowaway caught a free ride in your bag. No worries, they're the ones keeping the presents from falling out.

name: Holiday Courier Cape (AC)
description: A stowaway caught a free ride in your bag. No worries, they're the ones keeping the presents from falling out.

name: Holiday Jester's Tail (AC)
description: The jester jokes that that it has a mind of its own, and has a craving for chaos.

name: Holiday Jester's Tail (Non-AC)
description: The jester jokes that that it has a mind of its own, and has a craving for chaos.

name: Holiday Paragon Cape
description: Happy Birthday, Dage!

name: Holiday Paragon of Light Backshield
description: Members of the Bright Legion love Frostval… the sun shining on their armor and snow blinds their enemies and makes them look even MORE Good.

name: Holiday Paragon of Light Cloak
description: Members of the Bright Legion love Frostval… the sun shining on their armor and snow blinds their enemies and makes them look even MORE Good.

name: Hollow Dawn Grimoires
description: Fascinating tomes written by an author in the middle of the Shadow Fiend's trial. The frightened and delirious scrawls are nearly impossible to read, but hold incredible power if properly empathized with.

name: Hollow Dawn Spellbooks
description: Fascinating tomes written by an author in the middle of the Shadow Fiend's trial. The frightened and delirious scrawls are nearly impossible to read, but hold incredible power if properly empathized with.

name: Hollow Dragon Rune
description: A Dragon sacrificed their life to protect their Dragonlord. This powerful rune is proof of their bond.

name: Hollow Grace Texts
description: Fascinating tomes written by an author in the middle of the Shadow Fiend's trial. The frightened and delirious scrawls are nearly impossible to read, but hold incredible power if properly empathized with.

name: Hollowborn Aequitas
description: The Hollowborn Judge's sentence is final. Once in "sub judice", fundamental principles about justice, equality, equity and, above all, morality, will be weighed. Shadow Fiend is not unfair and has made the Hollowborn Judge unable to act unfairly. Therefore, no matter the outcome of the judgment, it will always be fair. The scale will always be in balance.

name: Hollowborn Altare Devotionis
description: The principles of Justice taught by the Hollowborn Judge influence the living, the reborn and the dead. No matter what stage of life they are in, the conviction for justice makes them faithful followers of the Hollowborn Judge. Control? Order? Penance? None of that matters. The feeling of devotion they feel for the liberating ideals of justice made them build an altar through which the Hollowborn Judge can exercise their jurisdiction.

name: Hollowborn Battlemage Rune
description: Gramiel's light fades, taking with it his magic and blessings. But the Shadow Fiend exists in both Dark and Light.

name: Hollowborn BeastMaster's Battlewrap (0 AC)
description: Are they carrying weapons to best beasts? Or has becoming Hollowborn turned them into beasts in the eyes of their former kin? Blades stab into their cape but to no avail; they have already overcome their fate. ﻿(Glow is customizable to eye color.)

name: Hollowborn BeastMaster's Battlewrap (AC)
description: Are they carrying weapons to best beasts? Or has becoming Hollowborn turned them into beasts in the eyes of their former kin? Blades stab into their cape but to no avail; they have already overcome their fate. ﻿(Glow is customizable to eye color.)

name: Hollowborn BeastMaster's Wrap (AC)
description: A Beastmaster wore this cape, and when they returned from the Shadow Fiend's trial, they became a beast themselves. (Glow is customizable to eye color.)

name: Hollowborn BeastMaster's Wrap (Non-AC)
description: A Beastmaster wore this cape, and when they returned from the Shadow Fiend's trial, they became a beast themselves. (Glow is customizable to eye color.)

name: Hollowborn Blade of Chaos Cape
description: The legendary sword that has been used by Drakath for nearly 13 years, and the shadows have made it even more powerful…

name: Hollowborn Blades
description: Always searching for ways to obtain more power, the Hollowborn Adept studies all types of combat. May the shadow fiend show you new paths and guide your lessons.

name: Hollowborn Blades Cape (0 AC)
description: Deep inside the shadowrealm, there is a place where strong warriors and powerful wizards live. Fallen heroes and villains called the name of the Shadow Fiend, and now they all ascended once again as HollowBorns!

name: Hollowborn Blades Cape (AC)
description: Deep inside the shadowrealm, there is a place where strong warriors and powerful wizards live. Fallen heroes and villains called the name of the Shadow Friend, and now they all ascended once again as Hollowborns!

name: Hollowborn Chaotic Wings
description: Soar through the dark aether on wings made of pure Chaos. Your opponents will not see you coming until its too late, and you unleash shadows on them!

name: Hollowborn Dark Rune Judicii
description: As a faithful follower of the Hollowborn Judge's Justice, Hel Fö carries with her an emblem of respect: the "Runes of Judgment". With that authority, Hel Fö invokes the jurisdiction of the Hollowborn Judge when they deem it necessary.

name: Hollowborn Darkblood Backblades
description: When a Darkblood becomes Hollowborn, they grapple with the idea that they can never die. At first, it's seen as a boon. Then, the Darkblood realizes that they've lost their sense of urgency. The will to fight to the end must be relearned.

name: Hollowborn Doom Cape
description: The style of cape worn by Hollowborn DoomKnights - the elite soldiers of the Shadowfiend!

name: Hollowborn Doom Cloak (Cape)
description: The style of cloak worn by Hollowborn DoomKnights - the elite soldiers of the Shadowfiend!

name: Hollowborn Doom Shade (Cape)
description: Made of pure shadows, Sepulchure's Essence embraces and follows you through your path, eternally.

name: Hollowborn Dragon Guardian (0 AC)
description: The bond between a Dragon and their Dragonlord was so strong, it inspired the Shadow Fiend to show mercy.

name: Hollowborn Dragon Guardian (AC)
description: The bond between a Dragon and their Dragonlord was so strong, it inspired the Shadow Fiend to show mercy.

name: Hollowborn Dragon Guardian Wings (AC)

name: Hollowborn Dragon Guardian Wings (Non-AC)

name: Hollowborn Dragon's Curse
description: You carry the strength of a Dragon, but is its weight a blessing or a curse?

name: Hollowborn Dragonlord Cloak
description: A cloak as dark as the trial that separated a Dragonlord from their lifelong Draconic partner.

name: Hollowborn DragonSlayer's Cape
description: To control a dragon takes strength. To control a dragon without it knowing you are the puppetmaster takes skill, stealth, and subterfuge.

name: Hollowborn DragonSlayer's Scarf
description: To control a dragon takes strength. To control a dragon without it knowing you are the puppetmaster takes skill, stealth, and subterfuge.

description: The trees are the world's antlers. Even when they are crushed and burned, they will grow back even after Lore goes silent. The Hollowborn Druid's aura defies rot and decay, having broken free from the laws of nature.

name: Hollowborn Druid's Burning Cape
description: Ancient foliage fashioned into a cape. It grew in the wellspring life, naturally lost its vibrancy, and now emits a haunting glow. Ripped from the cycle of life, its aura reflects a new doctrine of defying the laws of nature.

description: Ancient foliage fashioned into a cape. It grew in the wellspring life, naturally lost its vibrancy, and now emits a haunting glow. Ripped from the cycle of life, its aura reflects a new doctrine of defying the laws of nature.

name: Hollowborn Fiend Cloak
description: You shape your wings into a cloak and horns jut from your back.

name: Hollowborn Flame Portal
description: While it does look dangerous, this portal helps the Hollowborn connect to their brethren. Many are surprised how often they're forced to make a quick escape to their realm.

name: Hollowborn Frozen Crest (0 AC)
description: A symbol chosen by Your Highness. It's a reminder, to never stop until the whole world is encased in ice.

name: Hollowborn Frozen Crest (AC)
description: A symbol chosen by Your Highness. It's a reminder, to never stop until the whole world is encased in ice.

name: Hollowborn Judicium Imaginem
description: When the judging session commences, the appropriate time, place and time will be determined at the discretion of the Hollowborn Judge. ShadowFiend has given you permission to decide the location of your Jurisdictio, not needing to be physically present to judge.

name: Hollowborn Jurisdictio
description: The Hollowborn Judge delivers justice under the name of Shadow Fiend to all those who act contrary to his commandments. It is the Throne from which Justice emanates and the laws of ShadowRealm are determined. Once upon the Throne, the Hollowborn Judge attains their full power.

name: Hollowborn Legion Champion Crest
description: A cloak that belonged to Dage the Evil in times long gone. It was passed to a worthy disciple, and the Hollow glow is a symbol of their resolve - tested and proven.

name: Hollowborn Lich King's Cloak
description: Do not fear death. Do not become a slave to fate. Carried by their deepest desires, the Hollowborn persist. Knowing this, few question why the Lord of the Legion sees a little of himself in the character of his Hollowborn Legionnaires.

name: Hollowborn Nightmare Back Arm
description: Some DreamWalkers can send their minds through dreams and dimensions to get information or watch their enemies, but Hollowborn DreamWalkers are able to go there personally if needed. Though it is a gift from the Shadow Fiend to do such thing, it comes with a  price.

name: Hollowborn Paladin Cape
description: May the Shadowfiend guide your paths, Paladin

name: Hollowborn Paladin Cloak
description: May the Shadowfiend guide your paths, Paladin

description: The Hollowborn evolution of Lore's Greatest and darkest cape! This item is color customizable and will return for Dage's 2024 Birthday Collection + rares shop before going perma-rare.)

description: The Hollowborn evolution of Lore's Greatest and darkest cape! This item is color customizable and will return for Dage's 2024 Birthday Collection + rares shop before going perma-rare.)

name: Hollowborn Promise Ring
description: An unbreakable ring that will resist even the touch of death as long as promises are kept sacred.

name: Hollowborn Queen of Pain
description: A figure created in the image of the eternal Queen of Pain. May she grant these humble Slayers greater struggles and fortify their zeal for power.

name: Hollowborn Ranger Quiver
description: The Dawn Vindicator's light has been tainted with shadow. Silver, gold, and iron no longer slays evil. It offers up candidates to the Shadow Fiend to make into new Hollowborn.

name: Hollowborn Raven Cape (AC)
description: There's a lot you can learn and take from a person, even if they're dead with nothing but rags in the tundra. Pick at them until they're bones, and dig into the marrow. You'll practically become them.

name: Hollowborn Raven Cape (Non-AC)
description: There's a lot you can learn and take from a person, even if they're dead with nothing but rags in the tundra. Pick at them until they're bones, and dig into the marrow. You'll practically become them.

name: Hollowborn Reaper's Minion
description: Fallen warriors seeking for justice or revenge… it can be hard to tell the difference. Trained specially to fight infernal creatures, the Fiend Reaper is both slayer and puppetmaster.

name: Hollowborn Reaper's Sheathed Katana
description: Fallen warriors seeking for justice or revenge… it can be hard to tell the difference. Trained specially to fight infernal creatures, the Fiend Reaper is both slayer and puppetmaster.

description: Always searching for ways to obtain more power, the Hollowborn Executioner has mastered all types of combat. May the Shadow Fiend show you new paths and guide your lessons.

name: Hollowborn Shadow of the Legion
description: A bottomless arsenal of weapons granted to a loyal Hollowborn Legionnaire, with a guardian to keep them out of unworthy hands.

name: Hollowborn Shadow Shaper's Mana Aura
description: A fallen mage, now in servitude of the darkness and what lies there … A shadow manipulator who fuses them with his own mana, able to create and shape unique weapons, and strangely resistant minions. It is not common to see him in daylight, but hope never to find him in the darkness of night.

name: Hollowborn Spider Familiar
description: Black cats are more common, but some witches prefer fuzzy familiars with more legs.

name: Hollowborn Tamer's Quiver
description: May the Shadow Fiend show you new paths and guide your lessons… and may your arrows never run out.

name: Hollowborn Thorn Guardian
description: The Hollowborn Assassin who carries the name Castor looms over your shoulder as their poison drips from your hands. They aid their new Hollowborn kin, shielding them from death and giving others the opportunity to meet the Shadow Fiend.

name: Hollowborn Thunderlord Lightning Cape
description: The power of thunder and lightning is a difficult one to wield - one that only the most determined of Hollowborn can master.

name: Hollowborn Trainer's Companion
description: No mortal shall resist the shadows, not even the cutest of the moglins. Great help you have there now, Trainer. (Quest for House!)

name: Hollowborn Trainer's Companion Bank
description: No mortal shall resist the shadows, not even the cutest of the moglins. Great help you have there now, Trainer.

name: Hollowborn Treasure Hunter Bag
description: Sometimes it holds gold and gems, but you're more likely to find bones, pottery pieces, and broken tools inside. Learning about the way lives were lived is far more valuable than any shiny bauble or brooch.

name: HollowBorn Valkyrie's Wings
description: Without darkness, light cannot truly shine.

name: Hollowborn Vampire Flying Skulls
description: Death (well, UNdeath) helps to provide power to the Hollowborn Vampire. Who knows what they are going to use that power for…

name: Hollowborn Vampire Knight Wings
description: Lifted by dark wings, the Hollowborn Vampire Knights are in search of the cause of the plague that took their previous lives. In all likeliness, the Shadowslayers have found a new way to hunt them.

name: Hollowborn Vindicator Wings
description: These are the world's wings. They sprouted from barren shadows to defy the end.

name: Hollowborn Wreath of Thorns
description: At the end of a Elven Assassin's life, thorns sprout from their bodies. But when turned Hollowborn, the vines become an extention of their body. Tearing off a piece and sending it away can be seen as either a gift or a threat..

name: HollowNight Pumpkin Vines
description: Picked at the dark of the moon, these vines are not recommended for eating… but for wearing!

name: HollowNight Pumpkin Wings
description: Found during the dark of the moon, these tiny, flying gourds are not recommended for eating.

name: Hollowsoul Ghoul Chibifero Cape
description: The Hollowsoul Ghouls roam the halls of Hollowsoul Castle, but lately have been spotted roaming the shadows of MystCroft. It is too early to tell what kind of omen this may be.

name: Hollowsoul Ghoul Knight Captain's BackDirks
description: The Hollowsoul Ghouls roam the halls of Hollowsoul Castle, but lately have been spotted roaming the shadows of MystCroft. It is too early to tell what kind of omen this may be.

name: Holly Cape
description: A very holly cape that has survived many battles in order to protect the Frostval spirit.

name: Holo DataKnight EnergyCells
description: Battle alongside the Dragons of Time as you attempt to command the universe!

name: Holstered Drow Shotguns
description: Never leave the house without em! Only for use in extreme problem solving situations.

name: Holstered Harvest Rifle
description: Meant to be pointed at the plumpest of Turdrakens, able to pierce through thick scales and plummage.

name: Holstered Midnight Eroder Pistols
description: A Midnight the Light can't pierce, from where the Darkness can never escape. These pistols belonged to a pirate that remains in an oak casket trapped in the Midnight of the sea.

name: Holstered Seraphic Water Rifle (0 AC)
description: Seraphic engineers created this in secret, using blueprints brought from the future by Laken and his entourage. It can't be all work and no play. They'll use this technology for super soaking action first, then apply it to undead hunting later.

name: Holstered Seraphic Water Rifle (AC)
description: Seraphic engineers created this in secret, using blueprints brought from the future by Laken and his entourage. It can't be all work and no play. They'll use this technology for super soaking action first, then apply it to undead hunting later.

name: Holy Scuba Gear
description: It might not hold air, but it's definitely a fashion statement.

name: Honduras Pride Scarf
description: /Cheer for your country's olympic athletes! Good luck to everyone competing!

name: Honduras Spirit Scarf
description: Wear the official colors of your country proudly. Battle on!

name: Hong Kong Pride Scarf
description: /Cheer for your country's olympic athletes! Good luck to everyone competing!

name: Hong Kong Spirit Scarf
description: Wear the official colors of your country proudly. Battle on!

name: Honored Clouds Of Byakko
description: The white tiger has long been recognized as the true "king of the beasts." He is most honorable and worthy of your worship. If you serve him with a pure heart and absolute virtue, you will be rewarded.

name: Honored Mouse Tail
description: When you want to cosplay as a cute little creature but don't want to be a kitty AGAIN… this tail is the cape for you!

name: Honra Selvagem Feathers
description: The Carnaval brings out the wild side of everyone but you can still show your honor and heritage in this cape.

name: Honra Selvagem Quiver
description: The Carnaval brings out the wild side of everyone but you can still show your honor and heritage in this cape.

name: Hooded Druids Cloak
description: Druids never leave home without their hooded cloak!

name: Hoopy Cape
description: Whoooooooo I'm a scary ghoooost!!

name: Hoptimus Booster Wings
description: The boosters of a mecha battle frame, renamed from its original designation "Jebunny" to appeal to a wider audience. You're supposed to see its fight capabilities as 'long range hopping.'

name: Hoptimus Bunny Drones
description: The drones of a mecha battle frame, renamed from its original designation "Jebunny" to appeal to a wider audience. You're supposed to see its fight capabilities as 'long range hopping.'

name: Horc Anti-Stab Cape
description: Your enemies can't stab your back if they can't reach it! This cape will protect your vital bits until you can take your foes DOWN!

name: Horc Warrior Cape
description: Rhison skin cape is warmest. Little itchy sometimes.

name: Horcinating Cape
description: Are you Horcin' hard or hardly Horcin'?

name: Horcish Commander Spikes (AC)
description: Horc Commanders may sail on the sea, but are still like mountain — hard, tough, loyal. We keep the seas a near Bloodtusk Ravine free and strong, defending from Chaos.

name: Horcish Commander Spikes (Non-AC)
description: Horc Commanders may sail on the sea, but are still like mountain — hard, tough, loyal. We keep the seas a near Bloodtusk Ravine free and strong, defending from Chaos.

name: Horcish Furred Cape
description: Cape keep warm. Also keep blood off shoulders. Good place to store extra weapons. Free and strong!

name: Horned Infernal ArchFiend Cape
description: This cape is a remnant of the Infernal's origins. Eventually, time spent in the Fiend's Void will turn it into an extension of the their flesh.

name: Horned Underworld Rune
description: Lost souls wander the underworld. Those who retain a measure of their strength and skill may be recruited into the Infernal Underworld Army. They guard the realm itself, unattached to any faction.

name: Horns of the Jaan (AC)
description: The Jaan serve as the guardian spirits of the Djinn Realm. If you want to proceed you must pass their trials.

name: Horns of the Jaan (Legend)
description: The Jaan serve as the guardian spirits of the Djinn Realm. If you want to proceed you must pass their trials.

name: Horrified Keeper Cape
description: Not someone you'd want to meet in a dark alley. Or a lit alley for that matter.

name: House Crafter Cape
description: Ten points for showing your pride learning under Neveya in Crafting Magic at DragonRune.

name: House Druid Cape
description: Ten points for showing your pride learning under Maedoc in Druid Magic at DragonRune.

name: House Elemental Cape
description: Ten points for showing your pride learning under Warlic in Elemental Mastery at DragonRune.

name: House Necromancer Cape
description: Ten points for showing your pride learning under Mueran in Necromancy at DragonRune.

name: Hovercraft Cape
description: An electronic foreman whose duty are to capture random creatures for experimentation whether they'll be dead or alive in the process. When a little beast is detected, bombs away!

name: Hovering Sombrero Cape
description: Don't… don't be shy, don't be… terrified, with this helm you'll never take yourself for granted, feel rejected, or unwanted!

name: Howard's Stalking Grief
description: The memories of Howard's Grief will stay with you every time you look in the mirror.

name: Howling Spectral Lycan
description: Even the soul of an underhanded coward can take on the form of a relentless beast if steeped in enough curses and anguish. Death becomes a new beginning.

name: Howling Wizard's Cloak
description: You caught a falling star. In your castle, journey far. Just stay true to who you are.

name: Howling Wizard's Wings
description: You caught a falling star. In your castle, journey far. Just stay true to who you are.

name: Huemul Balloon

description: The power of the Ice dragon fuels within this scale-covered cape. For you to claim that magic after the dragon had been slain is a prestigious honor.

description: Ice, serene yet unforgiving. Beautiful and soft, yet painful to the touch. The cold will take your life, and hold you in its embrace forever.

name: Ice Gale Cape
description: A cloak made from the wing of an Ice Dragon. Rather than holding warmth, it keeps the chill in. Dragonbloods and Ice Elves were given these whenever they needed to venture to warmer lands.

description: A flawless blue crystal that never melts regardless of heat, but can still send a literal chill up one's spine or heal an injury.

description: Upon his travels, Shadowslayer Rei came across the tribe of Ichneumon Dragonslayers. This rune is the same rune the Ichneumon's have in their shrines, warding them from their foes. Carry this rune upon your back and pray that a dragon doesn't find you tasty.

name: Icy Bloodletters of Nulgath Cape
description: The Archfiend knows you're as cold as ice in battle… now you have Bloodletters to reflect that!

name: Icy Eternal Flame
description: The only way to melt a heart of ice is with FIRE!

name: Icy Infernal Tail
description: Hidden from sight for centuries, lurking below the frozen depths, these infernals now reek havoc on villagers and heroes.

name: Icy Undead Parrot
description: The savviest pirates have the coolest parrots… taken a bit more literally.

description: There could be gunpowder in that barrel. Or, there could be juice. One way to clear pirates off your ship is to run out on deck with this, screaming about taking everyone with you.

name: Immortal Bloodletter Deity (0 AC)
description: Fresh blood calls upon a deity of sacrifice and death to nourish the Underwold with culled lives. Its origins are unknown, but it represents the call of the end.

description: Fresh blood calls upon a deity of sacrifice and death to nourish the Underwold with culled lives. Its origins are unknown, but it represents the call of the end.

name: Immortal Chronomancer Wrap (Special)
description: These intrepid, timely explorers can step into a shadow in one time-stream and emerge from a completely different shadow in another time stream. Immortal Chronomancers transcend space and time and can be in all dimensions and infinities at once. Others who control time revere them and are strengthened by their presence.

name: Immortal Crusader Cape
description: As long as you stand together with your compatriots, you will NEVER be defeated! Your motto: Libertad O Muerte!

name: Immortal WarForge Cloak
description: Before the ProtoParagons regained sentience, they slumbered beneath a simple cloth meant to keep out dust. They're loathed to part with this cloak, even if it's nothing but shreds of fiber.

name: Immortalis Dominus
description: By the power of blood, breath, and bone, these dark magic users seek the ultimate prize: immortality… and they do not care who they must hurt to achieve it.

name: Imperial Arsenal
description: A rifle and sword are a standard part of the Imperial Infantry's equipment.

name: Imperial Assassin's Scarf
description: As the Volt Master's life came to a quiet end, the clouds stopped rumbling. He did not pass any teachings of warfare and conquest to his childen in the hopes that they would finally have peace. The sentiment only caused bitterness.

name: Imperial Chunin Scarf
description: A Chunin is a ninja field commander. Highly trained to attack from stealth but focusing on strength and power rather than agility and speed.

name: Imperial Doomknight Cloak
description: A cloak worn by the elite of the Shadowscythe. The moment an Imperial Doomknight sets foot on the ground, it becomes the territory of the Empire.

name: Imperial Lich Lord Cape (0 AC)
description: There are few jesters in the Underworld, but the Legion snickers at irony. Titles as grandiose as "Imperial Lord" were given to defeated and chained pawns compelled to serve obediently. Patience…Patience is key.

name: Imperial Lich Lord Cape (AC)

name: Imperial Noxus Spiked Tassels
description: Sally was the one who prepared Noxus' new body. She even put her sewing skills to use so he'd make his come back in style. Those 'Fashion Reanimated' magazines didn't go to waste!

name: Imperial Noxus Spikes
description: Did someone…yank the spiked tips off of an iron fence?

name: Imperial Shield Cape
description: A shield is a standard part of the Imperial Infantry's equipment.

name: Impish Alter Ego Tail

name: Impish Banner
description: The face glows mischievously, inspiring deep trouble.

name: Impish Hollowborn Tail
description: Whoever had this tail lost it in their previous life, but were reunited with it after it grew back. A surprise bonus for overcoming the Shadow Fiend's trial.

name: Impish Purple Tail
description: ﻿﻿﻿This is a tell tale sign of a trouble maker.

name: Impish Shadow Tail
description: This is a tell tale sign of a trouble maker.

description: The former owner of these wings was a vampire that ruled a quarter of Doomwood Forest five hundred years before the founding of the Necropolis. If his wings opened up, a flock of bats can be summoned. Fortunately, they can't be summoned anymore since his death severed his link to the plane of darkness.

description: A sword that becomes sharper and deadlier the more Evil souls it cuts down, but Heroes and Paladins can't handle its weight. The blade can only be wielded by sullied hands.

name: Reviled Black Dragon Ronin Banner (AC)
description: This banner swears allegiance to no one. The names of worthy opponents emblazon the flag as a declaration of mastery to other warriors.

name: Reviled Black Dragon Ronin Banner (Non-AC)
description: This banner swears allegiance to no one. The names of worthy opponents emblazon the flag as a declaration of mastery to other warriors.

name: Revolutionary Quiver
description: No one can truly describe the horror felt when someone loads a bow with an explosive rocket in lieu of an arrow.

name: Revontheus Legacy Figure (0 AC)
description: A vision from the abyssal void looms over you.

name: Revontheus Legacy Figure (AC)
description: A vision from the abyssal void looms over you.

name: Revontheus Legacy Spectral Weapons (0 AC)
description: The spectral arsenal of Revontheus' own making.

name: Revontheus Legacy Spectral Weapons (AC)
description: The spectral arsenal of Revontheus' own making.

name: Revontheus Legacy Wraps (AC)
description: The tattered cape of Revontheus.

name: Revontheus Legacy Wraps (Non-AC)
description: The tattered cape of Revontheus.

name: Rhapsodic Aura
description: An aura that commands respect and exudes deadly pride.

name: Rhapsodic Harp Wings
description: These harps were forged from the armor of famed Shadowscythe warriors. Their legends and infamy are sung through the strumming of these bloodied harpstrings.

name: Ride The Lightning
description: These shocking wings are made of pure electricity.

name: Riftbreaker Cape
description: Moving around in the rift is easier when you've a cloak to cover yourself with.

name: Riftbreaker Wings
description: The wings are only used if a Riftbreaker's cover is blown and they need to make a quick escape.

name: Riftwalker Anchored Portal
description: Riftwalkers are Atealan warriors who can cut reality with a single slash, and shatter dimensions with a single punch. Powerful Riftwalkers can flash through reality with a single swing of their blade.

name: Riftwalker Contemplative Portals
description: Riftwalkers are Atealan warriors who can cut reality with a single slash, and shatter dimensions with a single punch. Powerful Riftwalkers can flash through reality with a single swing of their blade.

name: Rimeblossom Enchanter Cape
description: The cape is passed from one enchanter to the next. If it senses that the Rimeblossom can grow with its new master, the crystals will begin to shift in color.

name: Rimeblossom Enchanter Ice Crystals (0 AC)
description: Delicately frozen in mid-air, the ice crystals float around the Enchanter, making it feel like time itself has stopped for them.

name: Rimeblossom Enchanter Ice Crystals (AC)
description: Delicately frozen in mid-air, the ice crystals float around the Enchanter, making it feel like time itself has stopped for them.

name: Rimecrystal Winglets (0 AC)
description: What looks like ice crystals are actually the bones of Queen Khione's Draconic bloodline. Fatal injuries could be easily mended by rare Rimeblossoms. Long after their deaths, those same flowers became as common as daisies.

name: Rimecrystal Winglets (AC)
description: What looks like ice crystals are actually the bones of Queen Khione's Draconic bloodline. Fatal injuries could be easily mended by rare Rimeblossoms. Long after their deaths, those same flowers became as common as daisies.

name: Rimecrystal Wings (0 AC)
description: What looks like ice crystals are actually the bones of Queen Khione's Draconic bloodline. Fatal injuries could be easily mended by rare Rimeblossoms. Long after their deaths, those same flowers became as common as daisies.

name: Rimecrystal Wings (AC)
description: What looks like ice crystals are actually the bones of Queen Khione's Draconic bloodline. Fatal injuries could be easily mended by rare Rimeblossoms. Long after their deaths, those same flowers became as common as daisies.

name: Ring of Bubbles Cape
description: A bubbly fun little cape.

name: Ring of Love
description: Forget about heart eyes, you're radiating with love! (CC to accessory)

name: Ripped Wings of the Underworld
description: Ripped from the back of a newly-slain frost dragon, these wings can be grafted onto your back… for a price.

name: Ripper Blades of the Legion Cape
description: Blades for combat that are also used to prep bones and marrow to use as reagents or new mindless minions. Magic is quicker and more efficient, but deeper control can be forged with skilled hands.

name: Rising Star
description: When a star collapses, there's no going back. You merely look to the stars, able to reach greater heights, and harness a brighter future.

name: Ritual Headstone
description: You can ask questions at this grave, and seek your answers in the flickering of the ghostly candles.

name: Roasted Hazelnut Sack
description: Perfect to roast over an open fire.

name: Robe of the Clerics
description: Donned by the Sisterhood as they move through the crowds, waiting and searching for Lore's true HERO!

name: Rocket on your Back
description: Are you a man with a rocket? Is your fuse burning out all alone? Do you think it will be a long, long time 'til you come back?

name: Rocket Pack
description: This should get you there faster…

name: Rockrun Flag
description: The Mercenaries of Rockrun wave their flags showing their allegiance to not only their city but Embersea Isle.

name: RockRune Cape
description: The mystical runes on this cape are ancient alchemical symbols. The prismatic crystal channels calming energy. A must for eager alchemists!

name: Rockstar Rogue Guitar Case
description: The greatest companion a rocker could ask for.

name: Rogue Cape
description: While larger memebrs of your party distract the foe, you slip up behind him and stab him in the back.

name: Rogue Fiend Cape of Nulgath
description: Black as night so the Rogue Fiend can move silently toward their next enemy.

name: Rogue Fiend Quiver of Nulgath
description: Sheathed behind your back for if your primary weapon does no good. When removed, they stick with the arm, becoming an extension to them until otherwise, removed.

name: Rogue of Time's Battle Gear
description: The light of these enchanted arrows is often mistaken for the power of Light. Care should be taken to shoot them correctly, should the arrow rip through the fabric of time and prevent a bystanders birth.

name: Rogue of Time's Quiver
description: The light of these enchanted arrows is often mistaken for the power of Light. Care should be taken to shoot them correctly, should the arrow rip through the fabric of time and prevent a bystanders birth.

name: Rogue's Discreet Cape
description: A rogue of love? Show your sweetheart that even the most thievish hearts can be won.

name: Rolith's Cape
description: The groom must have a cape being that he is Alina's superhero!

name: Romania Pride Scarf
description: /Cheer for your country's olympic athletes! Good luck to everyone competing!

name: Romania Spirit Scarf
description: Wear the official colors of your country proudly. Battle on!

name: Roots of Abundance
description: These roots are coiled and petrified, a Shadow of what they once were. Snakes are feared now, but they used to be protectors of the home.

name: Rose Aura of the Ascended
description: You have been granted a great honor: to wear the Rose Aura of the Ascended!

name: Rose Knight Cape
description: The Rose Knights seek to protect the beautiful, and rescue those in need. Don't worry if you don't think you're conventionally pretty. The tastes of these Knights vary wildly. Some will only rescue dragons.

name: Rose Knight Verdure
description: The Rose Knights pass out flowers as a sign of affection, and as a warning of their imminent arrival. It's easier to have many roses on hand.

name: Rose Quartz Wings
description: The beautiful pink wings of a butterfly can now be yours!

name: Roses and Gold Flame (AC) (1)
description: Let the passion of pink burn from your head. (Suggested by Fairies, Hanzo, and many more!)

name: Roses and Gold Flame (AC) (2)
description: Let the passion of pink burn from your head. (Suggested by Fairies, Hanzo, and many more!)

name: Roses and Gold Flame (Legend)
description: Let the passion of pink burn from your head. (Suggested by Fairies, Hanzo, and many more!)

name: Rosy Legion Vampire Bats (0 AC)
description: After sacrificing their undying souls to the Undead Legion, the Dark Lord transformed his most devoted followers into Legion Vampires. A new breed of Vampire has surfaced, and the world of Lore will soon witness the power of His chosen disciples…

name: Rosy Legion Vampire Bats (AC)
description: After sacrificing their undying souls to the Undead Legion, the Dark Lord transformed his most devoted followers into Legion Vampires. A new breed of Vampire has surfaced, and the world of Lore will soon witness the power of His chosen disciples…

name: Rosy Maple Moth Wings
description: This moth became a popular pet thanks to its adorable colors. They lay their eggs in trees, and the larvae are known to reduce long-lived maples into splinters. Their numbers have to be carefully managed to protect forests.

name: Rotting Wraithwings
description: A haunting pair of wings recycled from a fallen Wraith. Resisting the overwhelming smell is only half the fun.

name: Rouge Raider's Cape
description: You killed them, killed them all. They're dead, every single one of them. All of the enemies threatening your home. In the setting sunlight, the sands are tinted pink and gold with all their blood.

name: Royal Attendant Cape
description: A captivating cloak that matches the colors of a summer night sky. Usually worn by members of royalty, exceptions are made for attendants if their masters desire them to be seen and heard.

name: Royal Centurion Cape
description: Many serve Lascivia in her Hoard'em. This is the cape worn by those who serve as Royal Guards.

name: Royal Chaos Cape (0 AC)
description: The Queen of Monsters knows all. Sees all. Destroys all… Except those followers who prove worthy. Will you be one of them?

name: Royal Chaos Cape (AC)
description: The Queen of Monsters knows all. Sees all. Destroys all… Except those followers who prove worthy. Will you be one of them?

name: Royal Chaos Low Cape (0 AC)
description: The Queen of Monsters knows all. Sees all. Destroys all… Except those followers who prove worthy. Will you be one of them?

name: Royal Chaos Low Cape (AC)
description: The Queen of Monsters knows all. Sees all. Destroys all… Except those followers who prove worthy. Will you be one of them?

name: Royal Commander's Cape
description: You unlocked this cape and the rest of the Royal Commander set when you become one of the Lore’s greatest Heroes with a 1 month upgrade!

name: Royal Deathbringer Cloak
description: Needing the cover for darkness, the use of a heavy black cloak helps one blend seamlessly into the night.

name: Royal Dragonlord's Wrap
description: A Dragonlord was one of the leaders of the rebellion that freed Greenguard from tyranny. Another prevented the Shadows from taking Lore. All Dragonlords that serve the innocent are respected like royalty.

name: Royal DragonSlayer's BackBlade
description: Feared by dragons, wyverns, basilisks, and hydra, and serpents across the land, DragonSlayers are among Lore's most-skilled warriors and known for their unparalleled courage in battle.

name: Royal DragonSlayer's Cape
description: Feared by dragons, wyverns, basilisks, and hydra, and serpents across the land, DragonSlayers are among Lore's most-skilled warriors and known for their unparalleled courage in battle.

name: Royal DragonSlayer's Cape + Blade
description: Feared by dragons, wyverns, basilisks, and hydra, and serpents across the land, DragonSlayers are among Lore's most-skilled warriors and known for their unparalleled courage in battle.

name: Royal Electrowave Scholar's Quiver
description: These arrows aren't meant to be fatal. They paralyze potential test subjects so the scholars can safely bring them back to their labs.

name: Royal Eternal Flame
description: "All that is gold does not glitter… The old that is strong does not wither, deep roots are not reached by the frost." - the Wisest Wizard. May our love reach deeper than the coldest frost!

name: Royal Exalted ShadowSlayer Coat
description: When you are royalty, yet wish to be a Shadowslayer… you dress the part!

name: Royal Frost Cape
description: To keep cold during the long winters, bundle up and lead your people to salvation!

name: Royal FrozenSoul Wrap (0 AC)
description: Nature is cold, wet, hard and unforgiving. As are these courtiers.

name: Royal FrozenSoul Wrap (AC)
description: Nature is cold, wet, hard and unforgiving. As are these courtiers.

name: Royal GrenwogSlayer's Pom
description: Even royalty wants to get in on the GrenwogSlaying fun!

name: Royal GrenwogSlayer's Tassels
description: Even royalty wants to get in on the GrenwogSlaying fun!

name: Royal Guard Cape
description: A cape like this makes everyone look like a superhero. Just don't get caught in a powerful tornado or you'll regret wearing it…

name: Royal Herald Cape
description: These beautiful swords can only be worn by the respected officers of arms of Swordhaven.

name: Royal Knight's Wrap
description: The Royal Guard of Swordhaven swear only one vow: to protect the royal family with their swords, shields, and lives. It is an honor to serve Good.

name: Royal Legion Vampire Bats (0 AC)
description: After sacrificing their undying souls to the Undead Legion, the Dark Lord transformed his most devoted followers into Legion Vampires. A new breed of Vampire has surfaced, and the world of Lore will soon witness the power of His chosen disciples…
