description: After sacrificing their undying souls to the Undead Legion, the Dark Lord transformed his most devoted followers into Legion Vampires. A new breed of Vampire has surfaced, and the world of Lore will soon witness the power of His chosen disciples…

name: Royal Luxuria Sculpture Cape
description: When you are royalty, yet wish to be a Shadowslayer… you dress the part!

name: Royal Mage Cape
description: If you want to use the power of your magic for Good, the best place to study is with the Royal Swordhaven Mages. Learn all you can to protect Swordhaven and fight for Good!

name: Royal Mage Cape + Tome
description: If you want to use the power of your magic for Good, the best place to study is with the Royal Swordhaven Mages. Learn all you can to protect Swordhaven and fight for Good!

name: Royal Mage Floating Tomes
description: If you want to use the power of your magic for Good, the best place to study is with the Royal Swordhaven Mages. Learn all you can to protect Swordhaven and fight for Good!

name: Royal Nereidian Aquatic Shield (0 AC)
description: Deep below the waves, an entire civilization flourishes. The Nereidian people rule a vast underwater realm, but one that has never been fully explored by humans.

name: Royal Nereidian Aquatic Shield (AC)
description: Deep below the waves, an entire civilization flourishes. The Nereidian people rule a vast underwater realm, but one that has never been fully explored by humans.

name: Royal Paladin's Wrap
description: The title of Royal Paladin is only bestowed on the most powerful and loyal of the Order.

name: Royal Raider Wrap
description: A tattered shroud that was formerly worn by a little-known emperor from the east until it was stolen before his return home. While it falls into your possession, the emperor is still searching for a replacement.

name: Royal Red Death Cape
description: Like a thief in the night, you don this black cape.

name: Royal Roses Ornament
description: In days of old, the gardens of Swordhaven castle nurtured dangerously poisonous plants. The old dynasty's enemies were buried beneath those thorns, but they have since been replaced by the simple yet graceful rose. The noble court is allowed to pick the flowers and wear them.

name: Royal Serpent Antenor
description: The Forsaken Serpent Prince's divine mother sent a viper to assassinate him, but he tamed the venomous snake. It acts as his guardian, nesting in the wounds left by his distant family.

name: Royal Serpent Antenor Cloak
description: The Forsaken Serpent Prince's divine mother sent a viper to assassinate him, but he tamed the venomous snake. It acts as his guardian, nesting in the wounds left by his distant family.

name: Royal Shadowslayer's Coat
description: When you are royalty, yet wish to be a Shadowslayer… you dress the part!

name: Royal Summer Dufflebag Cape
description: A favorite accessory for young Swordhaven royals on summer beak from Skyguard Academy.

name: Royal Summer Parasol Cape
description: A favorite accessory for young Swordhaven royals on summer break from Skyguard Academy.

name: Royal Summer Tachi Cape
description: A favorite accessory for young Swordhaven royals on summer break from Skyguard Academy.

name: Royal Vampire Lord Cape (AC)
description: This is a special cape enhanced by Vampire Lords FOR Vampire Lords.

name: Royal Vampire Lord Cape (Merge)
description: This is a special cape enhanced by Vampire Lords FOR Vampire Lords.

name: Royal Weave Cape
description: Spun from webs and shadows.

name: Royal Wings of Brightfall (0 AC)
description: In the name of Empress Gravelyn the Good, defend your home from ANY forces that would threaten your realm.

name: Royal Wings of Brightfall (AC)
description: In the name of Gravelyn the Good, defend your home from ANY forces that would threaten your realm.

name: Royal Wings of Brightfall (Legend)
description: Nulgath the ArchAngel welcomes guardians of all species, races, and creeds… as long as they vow to fight for the good of the Mirror Realm!

name: Royal Winter Paladin Back Claymore
description: Avalanche, named for the crushing and unforgiving rage from the mountains. But they must happen, to uncover the secrets, traps, and blood hidden in shadow and snow.

name: Royal Winter Paladin Backblades
description: Starlight and Avalanche are the weapons of the Winter Paladin. The tundra can not remain dark forever, and though destructive, avalanches must fall to bring change to the land.

name: Royal Winter Snowflakes
description: Snowflakes are like stars that have gently fallen to the earth.

name: Ruby Dragonpriest Wings
description: Wings inspired by the legendary Fire Dragons.

name: Ruby Eternal Flame
description: Red is the color of heroes, and of luck. On the day of Lady Azjurai's wedding, we wish her and her fiance eternal happiness and felicity as they both battle through life together!

name: Ruby Flame Wings
description: Beautiful flame-colored wings made from Ruby Dragon scales.

name: Ruby Gothika Cape
description: Red is the color of love.

name: Ruby Kitsune Duelist Banner
description: The Duelists march as individuals, ready to lend their sword to a worthy cause, or to let others know that a Yokai Hunter will save the day.

name: Ruby Kitsune Duelist War March
description: The Duelists march as individuals, ready to lend their sword to a worthy cause, or to let others know that a Yokai Hunter will save the day.

name: Ruby Rune Cape
description: This crimson rune promises you aid in battle. And it looks pretty hot too.

name: Ruby Spell Shroud
description: The heart of the flame burns brightest in those mages willing to sacrifice everything for their power.

name: Ruby Yokai Pirate Sheathed Blade (0 AC)
description: Empress Ai no Miko rules over Yokai Isle, and we serve her best by patrolling the seven seas, defending her people and homeland. For the honor of the Thousand Years throne, we sail on!

name: Ruby Yokai Pirate Sheathed Blade (AC)
description: Empress Ai no Miko rules over Yokai Isle, and we serve her best by patrolling the seven seas, defending her people and homeland. For the honor of the Thousand Years throne, we sail on!

name: Ruby Yokai Shikigami
description: Spirits from the Yokai Realm who have yet to undergo reincarnation. They're leveraging their service as honorable guardians to score some good karma for the next life.

name: Ruff, Blade and Cape of the Light
description: The highest honor one can be bestowed upon, the Inquisitors are the very definition of Good.

name: Rugged Mercenary Cloak
description: This cloak has seen countless battles pelted by relentless storms, raining with arrows. All had the same outcome; a victory that becomes a small tally on the wall.

name: Ruins of Time Cape
description: Time tells no lies, and your time…is up.

name: Ruler of Darkness Cape
description: Once Heroes these beings fell into darkness never to come out.

name: Ruler of the Galaxy
description: Now you can /cheer for your favorite superstars, no matter where in the universe you are!

name: Runas de Protecao
description: This ring is worn by those sworn to protect the rainforest to their last breath. It symbolizes the unity of all loyal patriots defending their homelands.

name: Rune Cape of Duality (0 AC)
description: As the Admiral of the Great Abyss, Nulgath has bestowed a great power upon you, his most loyal Naval Commander. Whether you choose to use such power for Good or Evil is completely up to you…

name: Rune Cape of Duality (AC)
description: As the Admiral of the Great Abyss, Nulgath has bestowed a great power upon you, his most loyal Naval Commander. Whether you choose to use such power for Good or Evil is completely up to you…

name: Rune Cape of Na'al
description: ﻿﻿﻿Na'al, the Lord of the Scarred Barrens, would never have bent the knee in defeat… but he did not anticipate a hero with your power.

name: Rune Lord's Cape
description: Pay homage to the lord of the Northlands Warriors. He is the Spear Shaker, the Shield Breaker, and all who do battle honor him in this life… and (if they are worthy) in the next.

name: Rune Lord's Sigil Cape
description: Pay homage to the lord of the Northlands Warriors. He is the Spear Shaker, the Shield Breaker, and all who do battle honor him in this life… and (if they are worthy) in the next.

name: Rune of Darkness (Cape)
description: Using the power of the Shadows, these mages serve Gravelyn and the ShadowScythe in the battle against Malgor.

name: Rune of Fallen Shamans
description: Shaman Slayers who successfully killed a certain amount of Arcangrove's shamans are rewarded with this cape, to be worn as a trophy.

name: Rune of Light (Cape)
description: Using the power of the Shadows, these mages serve Gravelyn and the ShadowScythe in the battle against Malgor.

name: Rune of the Endless Oath
description: A rune that loops in on itself, bound and unbreakable. Eternity has a price, and the cost of this immortal spell is being robbed of the ability to make history.

name: Rune of the Fiend's Void (0 AC)
description: The spiralling circle requires an amount of mana that could completely drain an army. If enough is sacrificed, the land will near the event horizon of the Fiend's Feast.

name: Rune of the Fiend's Void (AC)
description: The spiralling circle requires an amount of mana that could completely drain an army. If enough is sacrificed, the land will near the event horizon of the Fiend's Feast.

name: Rune of the Grove
description: Blessed by Mother Nature herself, this cape serves as a symbol of protection through the rough times ahead.

name: Rune of the Heartless
description: A fiendish mark that sends a warning. Those who bear it can not be reasoned with. Begging will do nothing. Their only purpose is to break and destroy.

name: Rune of the Heartless + Tassels
description: A fiendish mark that sends a warning. Those who bear it can not be reasoned with. Begging will do nothing. Their only purpose is to break and destroy.

name: Rune of the Void Cloak
description: A runic circle that can spike the user's accuracy when launching ranged attacks, allowing each strike to be unavoidable.

name: Rune Spiral Cape
description: This rune reflects your power making it twice as nice.

name: Runed Archivist of Eras Cloak
description: The Archivist serves as the observer of the flow, holding the power to revise timelines as they deviate.

name: Runed Cape of Viltusial
description: So pure it's almost invisible when worn.

name: Runed Hollowborn Dragonlord Cloak
description: A Dragon sacrificed their life to protect their Dragonlord. This powerful rune is proof of their bond.

name: Runed Knight's Portal Cape
description: You recovered this mysterious, glowing item after defeating Lord Reignolds in his lair. It pulses with a strange, unsettling power.

name: Runed Knight's Wings
description: You recovered this mysterious item after defeating Lord Reingold in his lair. It pulses with a strange, unsettling power.

name: Runed Knight's Wings + Cape
description: You recovered this mysterious item after defeating Lord Reignolds in his lair. It pulses with a strange, unsettling power.

name: Runed Shadow Wings
description: Embrace the shadows but beware… the light of the celestial realm can harm you!

name: Runed Wings of Karok the Fallen
description: In Glacera the weak are buried under snow and ice. Karok's weakness died long ago, and allowed his icy wings to unfurl.

name: Runes, Interrupted
description: What will the break in this runic circle mean for your magic? Let's find out!

name: Runes of Agares
description: Agares, son of the Sand Lion, is the stealthiest Guardian. You will not see - or hear - him coming until his fangs are at your neck.

name: Runes of Flame (0 AC)
description: Avast ye! If you sailin' the seven seas as Pyroclastic pirate, make sure your swag be burstin' in fire and flame!

name: Runes of Flame (AC)
description: Avast ye! If you sailin' the seven seas as Pyroclastic pirate, make sure your swag be burstin' in fire and flame!

name: Runes of Flame + Cannon (0 AC)
description: Avast ye! If you sailin' the seven seas as Pyroclastic pirate, make sure your swag be burstin' in fire and flame!

name: Runes of Flame + Cannon (AC)
description: Avast ye! If you sailin' the seven seas as Pyroclastic pirate, make sure your swag be burstin' in fire and flame!

name: Runes Of Glacera
description: Channel the icy power of the planet Glacera to Freeze your enemies in their tracks!

name: Runes of the Solar Warden
description: Solar runes are uniform, expanding and contracting as they absorb and release heat. Mastery of these runes can be attained if a mortal finds favor from a Sunborn.

name: Runes of the Umbral Warden
description: The shadows glow with light. These runes are a rare existence that can be learned by anyone, but considered taboo by many. They expand and contract with your magical power and emotions.

name: Runes of the Void (AC)
description: The Empyrean Voids are among the highly-revered of Nulgath's nation. To ascend to their ranks, one must prove their worth in battle and blood for centuries.

name: Runes of the Void (Non-AC)
description: The Empyrean Voids are among the highly-revered of Nulgath's nation. To ascend to their ranks, one must prove their worth in battle and blood for centuries.

name: Runes of the Void Witch (AC)
description: Even in the Void witches find time to practice their craft.

name: Runes of the Void Witch (Legend)
description: Even in the Void witches find time to practice their craft.

name: Runes of Valthos
description: Valthos, Guardian of the Djinn Realm, targets his enemies' weaknesses. He is undefeated in single combat, and hoped to someday become Crulon's second in command.

name: Runes of Viltusial
description: So pure it's almost invisible when worn.

name: Runic Wings
description: These colorfull wings and holy glyphs will protect you, but only if your intentions are of good nature.

name: Russia Pride Scarf
description: /Cheer for your country's olympic athletes! Good luck to everyone competing!

name: Russia Spirit Cape
description: Show your World Cup Spirit!

name: Russia Spirit Scarf
description: Wear the official colors of your country proudly. Battle on!

name: Rustic Elven Quiver
description: Despite the somewhat foreboding name, the shawl was woven from the shade of greenguard's trees. It keeps the comforts of the forest elves' home close by.

name: S.S. Doom Minion Cape (AC)
description: Unlike other commanders in the Empire's employ, this captain is nothing but a puppet. Its Doomed master is the malevolent presence possessing their ship.

name: S.S. Doom Minion Cape (Non-AC)
description: Unlike other commanders in the Empire's employ, this captain is nothing but a puppet. Its Doomed master is the malevolent presence possessing their ship.

name: S.S. Phantom Backup Cutlass (AC)
description: The cutlass of a hapless pirate possessed by a phantom that once ruled the seas. It gained a deadly edge, guiding its wielder to add more ghosts to the crew.

name: S.S. Phantom Backup Cutlass (Legend)
description: The cutlass of a hapless pirate possessed by a phantom that once ruled the seas. It gained a deadly edge, guiding its wielder to add more ghosts to the crew.

name: S.S. Phantom Pirate Crest (0 AC)
description: A ship that flies this crest on their flag is possessed by ghosts. The phantom of a sunken ship takes over those who dare sail over its grave.

name: S.S. Phantom Pirate Crest (AC)
description: A ship that flies this crest on their flag is possessed by ghosts. The phantom of a sunken ship takes over those who dare sail over its grave.

name: S.S. Phantom Shark (0 AC)
description: In life, it was the beloved pet of a legendary pirate. It ate everyone that walked off the plank, and followed the S.S. Phantom's crew into the seas of death.

name: S.S. Phantom Shark (AC)
description: In life, it was the beloved pet of a legendary pirate. It ate everyone that walked off the plank, and followed the S.S. Phantom's crew into the seas of death.

name: Sack o' Clues
description: Who collects the elements and artifacts the Spellswords need to create these weapons? The Artifact Hunters!

name: Sack of Bacon
description: Everyone on the Nice List gets a giant, healthy, slice of crispy bacon. Zhoom is at the top of the list in big, bold letters. (For legal reasons, this is a joke. Cysero would never intentionally mess with Zhoom's bacon allergy.)

name: Sack of Coins (Cape)
description: It's a big sack. Of coins. Aren't you lucky?

name: Sacred Forest Dragon Tail
description: Peaches that grow from a Dragon's tail grant longevity. Persimmons will give you good fortune. And the Dragon that they belong to will give yo a good slap for harassing them.

name: Sacred Forest Dragon Wings
description: Every time a Nature Dragon flaps their wings, they shed seeds. They don't fly often, but when they do, barren lands reawaken.

name: Sacred Forest Dragon Wings and Tail
description: Every time a Nature Dragon flaps their wings, they shed seeds. They don't fly often, but when they do, barren lands reawaken.

name: Sakura Blossom Wings

name: Sheathed Beastly Chronicle Blade (AC)
description: A fine and regal blade found in the hands of the wild Iron Fang Warriors. It tells a silent tale of imprisonment, escape, and finally, freedom.

name: Sheathed Beastly Chronicle Blade and Tail (0 AC)
description: A fine and regal blade found in the hands of the wild Iron Fang Warriors. It tells a silent tale of imprisonment, escape, and finally, freedom.

name: Sheathed Beastly Chronicle Blade and Tail (AC)
description: A fine and regal blade found in the hands of the wild Iron Fang Warriors. It tells a silent tale of imprisonment, escape, and finally, freedom.

name: Sheathed Beastly Chronicle Blade (Non-AC)
description: A fine and regal blade found in the hands of the wild Iron Fang Warriors. It tells a silent tale of imprisonment, escape, and finally, freedom.

name: Sheathed Beastly Mettle Blade (0 AC)
description: It is impossible to truly tame a beast meant to lord over the wilds. This blade was strapped to a wolf, ordered to serve its master. The pack bit and clawed their way to freedom, their mettle proven.

name: Sheathed Beastly Mettle Blade (AC)
description: It is impossible to truly tame a beast meant to lord over the wilds. This blade was strapped to a wolf, ordered to serve its master. The pack bit and clawed their way to freedom, their mettle proven.

name: Sheathed Black Moon Blades
description: A weapon styled after the shape of the waning moon's shadow. As it hangs over the Sandsea, the worst of its monsters creep out of the desert. These blades await their challenge.

name: Sheathed Blade of Evil
description: It's always knife to meet a good meal.

name: Sheathed Blessed Beloved's Kris
description: A blade meant to be worn at all times. It shows that you're always ready to protect your family, and all that they hold dear.

name: Sheathed Blood Isles Rapier
description: A rapier left behind by a noble seafarer were claimed by the Blood Isles. It gleams, as shiny as it was the day gold poured into the mold.

name: Sheathed Blood Rage Sword (AC)
description: A selfish blade that hungers to spill blood in righteous fury. For its tainted steel and their wielder, justice is a delusion.

name: Sheathed Blood Rage Sword (Non-AC)
description: A selfish blade that hungers to spill blood in righteous fury. For its tainted steel and their wielder, justice is a delusion.

name: Sheathed Breaker Blade
description: Your enemies will freeze in fear when you step onto the battlefield!

name: Sheathed Cardletter Katanas
description: Not meant for duels in the rain.

name: Sheathed Celestial Starsaber
description: The light of this weapon came from a radiant ancestor. Their eyes are as numerous as the stars. Even now, they watch the progress of the progeny.

name: Sheathed Chaos Sword
description: You may follow Chaos, but that does not mean you can't do it in STYLE!

name: Sheathed Cold Extinction Blade
description: The FrostBlood burdened by this blade could be human. Perhaps they're an elf, or even a Glaceran. The cold overwelmed them, and forced its will into their hands. (This item is color-customizable to Base, Trim, and Accessory.)

name: Sheathed Cold Steel Sword (0 AC)
description: "There's something not right about the swords they wield. They have an eerie glow about them as if it's drawing strength out of the coldness in the air."

name: Sheathed Cold Steel Sword (AC)
description: "There's something not right about the swords they wield. They have an eerie glow about them as if it's drawing strength out of the coldness in the air."

name: Sheathed Collector Blade
description: Although their ways are founded i magic, that doesn't mean Blood Collector's won't put up a fight, if needed.

name: Sheathed Crimson Hesperides
description: A blade crafted from the blood of the legendary Atlas Lion. Ghastly rumors say that this golden king sacrificed his children to outrun old age. The honor of eradicating all Evils of this world was his right alone.

name: Sheathed Cutlass of Awe
description: "Could dis be the real thing? The wielder o' dis legendary artifact be granted massive power!" If you shout that at Lolosia's docks, you'll get laughs and tomatoes…but is it the real thing? Did you actually just find it that easily in the sand?

name: Sheathed Cyber Shinobi Zero Katana (0 AC)
description: A cyber secret taken deadly form. The 0day weakness are prized, and each Zero Katana is hand-designed to destroy a single target.

name: Sheathed Cyber Shinobi Zero Katana (AC)
description: A cyber secret taken deadly form. The 0day weakness are prized, and each Zero Katana is hand-designed to destroy a single target.

name: Sheathed Cyber Shinobi Zero Katanas (0 AC)
description: A cyber secret taken deadly form. The 0day weakness are prized, and each Zero Katana is hand-designed to destroy a single target.

name: Sheathed Cyber Shinobi Zero Katanas (AC)
description: A cyber secret taken deadly form. The 0day weakness are prized, and each Zero Katana is hand-designed to destroy a single target.

name: Sheathed Cypress Scalpel
description: A deadly weapon meant for precise slicing and clean cuts. Outside of battle, it was used to carve and sculpt frozen statues. Some of them were alive, just warm enough to feel every slice.

name: Sheathed Dark Cutlass
description: A cutlass gleaming with gold that was found inside a wooden chest locked away in an isolated grotto near Dwarfhold Mountains. Legend has it that its user could detect gold coins and valued treasures by how bright it gets.

name: Sheathed Dark Hand's Slaughter
description: The Dark Hand Behemoth brutally crushes their opponents in a roaring frenzy of blood. When their prey stops moving, a horrible sense of disappointment washes over them, and they set their sights on their next duel.

name: Sheathed Dekanor's Disparia (0 AC)
description: Named for the Great Dragon of Darkness, the dream of all Legion Dragonlords. None of them know what the real Dekanor looks like, so the face adorning this blade is but a fantasy.

name: Sheathed Dekanor's Disparia (AC)
description: Named for the Great Dragon of Darkness, the dream of all Legion Dragonlords. None of them know what the real Dekanor looks like, so the face adorning this blade is but a fantasy.

name: Sheathed Dragon Leviathan
description: A heavy weight on your back such as a draconic blade can easily be used exceptionally well if a spirit lurking within is awakened from its slumber in order to adapt to you.

name: Sheathed Dual Kagutsuchi Inori
description: The flames can only be lit with blood. A swordsmith modeled these masterpieces after a child of flame. Their birth and immediate death created eight volcanos.

name: Sheathed Dual Vector Helaine
description: Feared blades that welcomed the embrace of the storm. If they're stabbed into the ground, the land will be struck by lightning until the soil turns into charred ashes. They're named after King Gaheris' Queen, which did little to please her.

name: Sheathed Elite Polar Katana (AC)
description: The cold cuts through bone, freezing blood in an instant. Your quarry falls, shattering into pieces, left to melt into the gutter.

name: Sheathed Elite Polar Katana (Non-AC)
description: The cold cuts through bone, freezing blood in an instant. Your quarry falls, shattering into pieces left to melt into the gutter.

name: Sheathed Fiendish Erlösung
description: Fiends can only be redeemed when they're all cold and dead. Nulgath imbued these blades with his cold spite, completing two of many weapons meant to slay and replace Adimonde, the God of Fiends.

name: Sheathed FlameBlade Blade
description: The heat from these will keep the most reclusive assassin warm.

name: Sheathed Giftwrap Cape
description: You never know when you'll come across a present to wrap!

name: Sheathed GL-1ST Salvage Blade
description: A weapon made from a droid's spare limb. Better this than nothing at all. (This item is color-customizable to Accessory)

name: Sheathed Glacial Knight Cape
description: These knights sparkle and shine under the glow of the New Years ball when it drops.

name: Sheathed Grenwog DracoSword
description: A sword able to withstand Dragon fire and the bone shattering fists of a Grenwog. You'll be frying their eggs in no time.

name: Sheathed Heldenlied
description: This is a blade pledged to a Hero. A flock of Gryphons who bonded to a young warrior flew into the unknown for a full year, returning with a mysterious sword. The blade is ready for its next heroic epic.

name: Sheathed Higure (0 AC)
description: It is impossible to run away from this black blade. I wonder if there is a more worthy hero to wield it?

name: Sheathed Higure (AC)
description: It is impossible to run away from this black blade. I wonder if there is a more worthy hero to wield it?

name: Sheathed Hip Sword
description: Although their ways are founded in magic, that doesn't mean Blood Collector's won't put up a fight, if needed.

name: Sheathed Hongbaoshi Blade (AC)
description: (This is the 0 AC version available in the Treasure Chest.)A ruby blade that represents the burning passion in a Dragon's breath. Being gifted this weapon from Earthen Dragons is akin to a promise of protection.

name: Sheathed Hongbaoshi Blade (Non-AC)
description: (Alternate 0 AC version available in the Treasure Chest.)

name: Sheathed Hope Blade
description: The extended endurance in the extreme climates have caused small ice particles to be naturally attracted to the right side of the blade, explaining its partial cyan hue in the present day. Talk about chilling out.

name: Sheathed Icerender
description: Brotherblade to the Iceheart, the Icerender may only be drawn when the world has ended… and one must break through the ice to a new dawn!

name: Sheathed Incendiary Cutlass (AC)
description: A cutlass forged from mana-infused, superheated metal. It's extremely volatile, and likely to cause an explosion on impact. Only someone who doesn't sixth-degree burns should wield it.

name: Sheathed Incendiary Cutlass (Non-AC)
description: A cutlass forged from mana-infused, superheated metal. It's extremely volatile, and likely to cause an explosion on impact. Only someone who doesn't mind sixth degree burns should wield it.

name: Sheathed Infernal Starsaber
description: When a star collapses into a black hole, it can never go back to what it once was. Powered by raw hatred and despair, this weapon drags its enemies down with it.

name: Sheathed Iron Blade Cape (1)
description: Sometimes one cannot carry their weapon, but it should always be close at hand, because you never know when someone till try to betray you… and take over the brigade!

name: Sheathed Iron Blade Cape (2)
description: Those conquering new territories in the Northlands know that blades can break or be lost. A wise warrior knows to always carry a backup weapon.

name: Sheathed Ivory Thorn
description: A blade trapped in an iron sheath, and bound in thorns. It was given to the coliseum, fated to find a wielder that can satisfy it's thirst for sullied blood.

name: Sheathed Jade Dragonguard Katanas
description: Thin layers of steel hide cores made of pure Jade, blessed by the Empress to help ward off evil. In Wuji, Jade symbolizes eternity and immortality. To the Isles, it represents hope and unity.

name: Sheathed Joy Blade
description: The Northlands Ranger travel the frozen wastes in search of Good heroes to reward with silver, gold, and treasure beyond compare… ensuring a most joyful winter season!

name: Sheathed Katana
description: Even sheathed, these blades are still as deadly as ever!

name: Sheathed Katanas
description: The best way to carry your katanas.

name: Sheathed Kimon Benevolence Nagamaki
description: A blade made by the Great Yokai Spirit that is strongest when it's used to defend the innocent. Unfortunately, that magic only activates in the hands of an Oni, who are known to eat the innocent.

name: Sheathed King's Hallowed Blade (0 AC)
description: A blade created from pale moonlight shining on darkness. It was awarded to the first of the Unhallowed Wights before being passed to the next generation, and the next, searching for one who would eclipse the moon.

name: Sheathed King's Hallowed Blade (AC)
description: A blade created from pale moonlight shining on darkness. It was awarded to the first of the Unhallowed Wights. It passed to the next generation, and the next, searching for one who would eclipse the moon.

name: Sheathed Kinsman Sword (Cape)
description: Just as a proud beast needs sleep, your blade needs rest to stay sharp.

name: Sheathed Kitsune Katanas (0 AC)
description: *No description*

name: Sheathed Kitsune Katanas (AC)
description: *No description*

name: Sheathed Kuro and Oni
description: The black blade balances the red oni blade.

name: Sheathed Kurogatana
description: The black blade will soon be stained red.

name: Sheathed Lightblade (0 AC)
description: The brighter the light, the darker the shadow. The Future Legion's steel will consume both.

name: Sheathed Lightblade (AC)
description: The brighter the light, the darker the shadow. The Future Legion's steel will consume both.

name: Sheathed Long Rest
description: The Darknight Stalkers roam the frozen wastes of the dark north in search of any who have wronged their friends and family. Once found, they are swiftly — justly — punished.

name: Sheathed Melody Of The Rose (Cape)
description: As the sun rises over the mountains, a condor calls the warriors to battle. The Dawn Duelists prepare to defend their home. They will give their life for the land and people they love so much.

name: Sheathed Mercy's Touch (AC)
description: An intentionally blunted blade that inflicts horrendous pain on both the living and the dead. It's name comes from it's final touch, which puts its master's victim out of their misery.

name: Sheathed Mercy's Touch (Non-AC)
description: An intentionally blunted blade that inflicts horrendous pain on both the living and the dead. It's name comes from it's final touch, which puts its master's victim out of their misery.

name: Sheathed Midnight Joy Blade (AC)
description: The Northlands Rangers travel the frozen wastes in search of good heroes to reward with silver, gold, and treasure beyond compare… ensuring a most joyful winter season!

name: Sheathed Musket
description: : Muskets are proven to be super effective against turkeys. But just turkeys.

name: Sheathed Noble Amethyst Katanas
description: Each of the Yokai Isles’ Noble Houses passes a pair of blessed blades from one family head to the next. They must be periodically purified at a shrine to keep evil spirits from possessing the heirlooms.

name: Sheathed Noblesse Mortelle Rapier (0 AC)
description: Death, the great equalizer. Everyone will meet the reaper one day. The heroes of Brightfall face their own mortality, noble and brave. If they must, they will bring honorable death to when there are no other options.

name: Sheathed Noblesse Mortelle Rapier (AC)
description: Death, the great equalizer. Everyone will meet the reaper one day. The heroes of Brightfall face their own mortality, noble and brave. If they must, they will bring honorable death to when there are no other options.

name: Sheathed Oni Blood Katanas (0 AC)
description: The Oni's katanas were transformed by the Fiend's Void, and thirsts for the blood of their former brethren. They exemplify both the creed of the Oni, and the maxims of the Nation.

name: Sheathed Oni Blood Katanas (AC)
description: The Oni's katanas were transformed by the Fiend's Void, and thirsts for the blood of their former brethren. They exemplify both the creed of the Oni, and the maxims of the Nation.

name: Sheathed Oro Rosa Rapier
description: Defend your home, ways, and love with pride.

name: Sheathed Orochi Wakizashi
description: The blades that wear Orochi's name are considered its younglings, forged from materials taken from its living body. Depending on who's blood seeps into the blade and why, a new yokai will be born and the weapon will be its body.

name: Sheathed Protoslasher
description: Dage has entrusted this with one of his commanders who then gave it one of this subordinates to gain a chilly edge.

name: Sheathed Providence
description: Mystical threads weave their way through the sublime cloth that surrounds you. Mana energy flows freely in the air around you, and you feel almost… divine.

name: Sheathed Psion Blades (AC)
description: Crystallis ProtoAssassins exist only in rumors and the shadows… right up until their blades are pressed against your throat.

name: Sheathed Psion Blades (Non-AC)
description: Crystallis ProtoAssassins exist only in rumors and the shadows… right up until their blades are pressed against your throat.

description: "Could dis be the real thing? The wielder o' dis legendary artifact be granted massive power!" If you shout that at Lolosia's docks, you'll get laughs and tomatoes…but is it the real thing? Did you actually just find it that easily in the sand?

name: Sheathed Revelry of Múspell
description: A warrior, who burned in sacred fire, promised to return to engulf his enemies in sacred flame. He ascended, but flew to join his brethren in the sun. Fatal misunderstandings let to many Champions of Fire being mistaken for Surtr.

name: Sheathed Revelry of Surtr
description: A warrior, who burned in sacred fire, promised to return to engulf his enemies in sacred flame. He ascended, but flew to join his brethren in the sun. Fatal misunderstandings let to many Champions of Fire being mistaken for Surtr.

name: Sheathed Reviled Androktasia (0 AC)
description: An evolved form of the Legion torturers' most coveted blades. This sword contains a portion of the Executioner's soul to ensure a 'deeper' experience. They feel the sensation of their blade slicing through a neck as if it's their own.

name: Sheathed Reviled Androktasia (AC)
description: An evolved form of the Legion torturers' most coveted blades. This sword contains a portion of the Executioner's soul to ensure a 'deeper' experience. They feel the sensation of their blade slicing through a neck as if it's their own.

name: Sheathed Rifle
description: Even though you have a pistol on your hip and a six-shooter in your hand, it's always good to have a back-up plan. On your back.

name: Sheathed Ruby Kitsune Katanas
description: Weapons gifted from Yokai for the express purpose of hunting others of their kind are inherently cursed. The shrines of the Yokai Isles see many visitors seeking purification rituals.

name: Sheathed Sailor's Cutlass
description: YARRRR! This floating ship-shaped dungeon was the BEST IDEA EVER… The dungeon goes to the challengers. There is no escape! AHAHAHAHAHAHA!

name: Sheathed Seraph Katanas
description: A samurai's prized possession is always their blade.

name: Sheathed Seraphic Blade
description: Seraphic Surveillance Agents are charged with eternal vigilance. "Quis custodiet ipsos custodes? Facimus."

name: Sheathed Seraphic Fourth Blade
description: When a member of the Seraphic Order falls, their cybernetic enhancements are taken. They're turned into weapons until they resonate with someone worthy to be fused with them.

name: Sheathed Side Shotgun
description: … Shouldn't this be on your back? That's how all the 'slayers on TV sheathe them. Careful how you sit down!

name: Sheathed Soulblade
description: The brighter the light, the darker the shadow. The Future Legion's steel will consume both.

name: Sheathed SpellBlade
description: An elemental sword forged by a master!

name: Sheathed SpellFrost Mage Blade
description: SpellFrost Mages are known for their mastery of Cryomancy. They are among the most skilled mages of the Northlands, and the sapphire gems they wear are made of crystallized skyfire.

name: Sheathed Temple Blade
description: Celebrate the Thai new year in festive style!

name: Sheathed Traveler's Swords
description: Mercenaries should always carry several weapons, but it looks like these blades should have brought an extra mercenary.

name: Sheathed Tribal Blade
description: We wish you a Yeti New Year!

name: Sheathed Turdraken Carvers
description: These machetes see action in the woods and at the dinner table.

name: Sheathed Underworld Katana
description: Though the Underworld has existed since the first life expired, it keeps up with the times. Or, it even moves ahead of the game.

name: Sheathed Underworld Rage
description: Though the Underworld has existed since the first life expired, it keeps up with the times. Or, it even moves ahead of the game.

name: Sheathed Urban Duelist Katanas
description: Astravia's ancient rulers stole swords from distant lands, and a servant snuck them out of the castle. The commoners forged copies, arming the Duelists with weapons to train with.

name: Sheng Chi Backblades
description: When in the direst of situations, this ancient artifact will call upon previous guardians for protection.

name: Sheng Long Backblades
description: When in the direst of situations, this ancient artifact will call upon previous guardians for protection.

name: Shielded Lethe Cloak
description: Soaked in the pitch black waters of oblivion, travelers who carry this cloak on their shoulders were exiled for their crimes - forced to forget the place they once called home.

name: Shimmering Constellations
description: Your own personal constellations sparkle, mapping both fortune and fate.

name: Shimmering Flakes
description: No, you don't need better shampoo--these magical snowflakes will always fall, no matter what time of year it is!

name: Shining Light Frame
description: It's as if a light of hope shines down upon you at all times…

name: Shining Light Royalty Cloak
description: Stupendous! You always knew you were bound for royalty… and now you look the part!

name: Shinobi's Dragon Soul
description: Ninjas are hailed for their dexterity. Dragons are praised for their strength. And when the Ninja trains in the way of the Dragon, they shall become a master of brutal warfare!

name: Shinobow and Arrows
description: The Shinobi is know for this precise aim. When throwing stars won't reach far enough, /unsheath your bow and let your arrows take flight into the fight!

name: Ship Cemetery
description: If you strain your ears, you'll hear the ghostly echoes of the bloody battle that wrecked these decaying ships.

name: Shipwrecked Anchor (0 AC)
description: Well at least you saved the anchor!

name: Shipwrecked Anchor (AC)
description: Well at least you saved the anchor!

name: Shipwrecked Captain's Rune
description: This all seeing horus will keep an eye out.

name: Shipwrecked Pirate Backblades (0 AC)
description: Once Captains of the great ships that now lay at the bottom of Davy Jones' locker these pirates now be looking for turtles to strap to their feet.

name: Shipwrecked Pirate Backblades (AC)
description: Once Captains of the great ships that now lay at the bottom of Davy Jones' locker these pirates now be looking for turtles to strap to their feet.

name: Short Holly Cloak
description: The spirits will be by your side and protect you from all that is evil.

name: Shoulder Barn Owl
description: Regularly dispenses polite hoots and would prefer walks in the shade.

name: Shower of Affection
description: The prelude to a fluffy, suffocating dream.

name: Shower of Flowers Cape
description: Walk the red carpet in this stylish frock while rocking to the Zardile Rock!

name: Shredwake Electrosensors
description: Foldable sensors that can detect changes in electric currents, allowing you to sense the movements of your prey. Warning - systems will fail if you get turned upside down.

name: Shredwake HydroCore Unit
description: Foldable sensors that can detect changes in electric currents, allowing you to sense the movements of your prey. Warning - systems will fail if you get turned upside down.

name: Shrine of Prophetic Visions
description: The ShadowScythe Seer uses their powers only for evil, to ensure that Gravelyn's Empire remains unbroken.

name: Shroomknight Cloak
description: Most heroes believe the ShroomKnight shows little sympathy for humans. But once you get to know him, he's really a fungi.

name: Shroud Of Dreams
description: The twilight which blankets the Land of Dreams and Nightmares has coalesced to form a flowing cloak.

name: Shroud of the Dark Star
description: In Darkness, sleep in peace. The one who made the Avatar of Darkness the most powerful of his kin soon realized this shroud had transformed into a cage.

name: Shroud of the River Styx
description: Dage accepts all types of capes: worn, torn, aflamed. All act the same in battle.

name: Shroud of the Waiting Sands
description: The river of time is meant to carry you forward. Some get stuck, and are forced to watch the world pass them by.

name: Shu Ninja Streamers
description: It is the Year of the Rat, and these colorful Ninja are celebrating!

name: Shu Ninja Tail
description: It is the Year of the Rat, and these colorful Ninja are celebrating!

name: Side Phoenix Blade (1)
description: From the ashes the phoenix will rise. Only the most proven veterans of Lore carry this sword of rebirth.

name: Side Phoenix Blade (2)
description: From the ashes the phoenix will rise. Only the most proven veterans of Lore carry this sword of rebirth.

name: Sidhe's Devotee Wrap
description: The creations and deeds of Leanan Sidhe's adored ones grow in brilliance as their creators slowly wither away.

name: Sielu's Wings
description: A pair of wings once worn by a blacksmith in another timeline.

name: Silent Snowfall
description: Snow does make a sound when it falls. You can hear it when the night sky turns a little blue, just before the sun rises.

name: Silent Wanderer Arrows
description: These wanderers drift through Yokai offering cutting comments on your hairstyles. They sometimes offer to cut your hair… while blindfolded. No thanks!

name: Silent Wanderer Scissors Hip
description: These wanderers drift through Yokai offering cutting comments on your hairstyles. They sometimes offer to cut your hair… while blindfolded. No thanks!

name: Silver and Gold Eternal Flame
description: "All that is gold does not glitter… The old that is strong does not wither, deep roots are not reached by the frost." - the Wisest Wizard. May your love reach deeper than the coldest frost!

name: Silver Bouquet-on-Your-Back
description: Sometimes you just gotta get the flowers of the way and pick up a sword!

name: Silver Crescent Cape (0 AC)
description: The moon will only take this shape on nights overflowing with magic. This cape was crafted during such a night to capture the mystic power of that fleeting moment.

name: Silver Crescent Cape (AC)
description: The moon will only take this shape on nights overflowing with magic. This cape was crafted during such a night to capture the mystic power of that fleeting moment.

name: Silver Cyborg Monk Arms
description: Martial arts can be pushed further. One only needs accept that the body at birth is lacking. As in lacking an extra set of ripped arms.

name: Silver Dream Guardian Cape
description: There are many creatures that stalk the lands of the Djinn Realm, and the Guardians of the Dream Palace protect all who dwell within.

name: Silver Enchanted Pyro Wrap
description: AHAHAH! BURN THE WORLD! BURN IT ALL DOWN! NO REMORSE NO REGRET JUST FIRE! AHAHAHA (This item is color customizable.)

name: Silver Eternal Flame
description: Usually people promise eternal love with gold, but silver is a much classier way to go.

name: Silver Exalted Haloed Wings
description: Unfortunately, Trolle'din died when a foe told him his shoelace was untied. Down he looked, to double-check, and his enemy took off his head - at the neck!

name: Silver Gunsmith Wings
description: Crafted by enven, these wings will shine down on your friends, glowing with a beneficent light which will lead them to victory!

name: Silver Horned Dragon Companion (0 AC)
description: Yarrrr! Most landlubbers never hear of th' fleet o' ships the DragonLords command. But th' dragon companions be fearsome fighters on land, sea, AND air.

name: Silver Horned Dragon Companion (AC)
description: Yarrrr! Most landlubbers never hear of th' fleet o' ships the DragonLords command. But th' dragon companions be fearsome fighters on land, sea, AND air.

name: Silver Pisces Cradle Wings
description: The constellation of Pisces was born from a tale of the goddess Lupercalia transforming themselves and their children into fish to hide from Valentidus Sr. The love goddess bestowed beauty upon the Pisces form in gratitude.

name: Silver Pisces Fae Wings
description: The constellation of Pisces was born from a tale of the goddess Lupercalia transforming themselves and their children into fish to hide from Valentidus Sr. The love goddess bestowed beauty upon the Pisces form in gratitude.

name: Silver Sagittarius Boosters
description: The hunters gallop through galaxies, kicking up stardust and mysterious. These boosters were drilled into their backs after their capture. Each day, the cosmos grow more and more savage.

name: Silver Savior's Magical Wrap
description: No matter how vast the invading army, no matter how massive the monster, no matter how powerful the villain… the heroes of Battleon will ALWAYS rise to defend their home. And battling together, they will ALWAYS win.

name: Silver Shotgun On Your Back (AC)
description: A blast through the chest, and you're to blame. Undead UndeadSlayer, you give irony a bad name.

name: Silver Shotgun On Your Back (Legend)
description: A blast through the chest, and you're to blame. Undead UndeadSlayer, you give irony a bad name.

name: Silver Skye Reserve Armaments
description: Weapons meant to be inherited, and passed from one generation to the next, in an unbroken line back to the first warriors of Skye. The steel has been burned by fiery dragon's breath, enchanting it with strength.

name: Silver Swashbuckler's Navigator
description: Pay no attention to the squid in the tank. It's just a pet, and certainly not in control of this steel golem. Now, have you considered appealing to the God of the Depths to steer the ship towards more terror? Treasure! I meant treasure.

name: Silver Tentacle Wings (AC)
description: Don't be too late. These heavy wings of pure gold were not forged to fly, but to stand out at dinner parties.

name: Silver Tentacle Wings (Legend)

name: White Ermine Moth Wings
description: The speckled wings of this moth are stylish and ubiquitous. They once lived all over Lore, commonly used as ingredients for spells and potions. Overhunting has lead to their disappearance from several regions.

name: White Feather Wings
description: These wings show your focus and determination to receive the things you desire.

name: White Flag Cloak
description: Made from materialized snow, this cape represents peace, purity, and innocence. Also makes a great ghost costume and surrender flag!

name: White Fur Cape
description: After sprinting in this cloak, you'll both be fast and the furriest.

name: White Fur Cloak
description: Oooh so furry, and so soft! Made entirely out of chinchilla fur.

name: White Lotus Aurora Petals
description: When a White Lotus blossoms in your chest, you'll grow petals too. They reflect the aurora - the color of your soul.

name: White Lotus Rune
description: The rune is a spiral of petals, growing and dying. Flowers wilt. Snow melts. One's time is limited, so you must make it count.

name: White Lotus Sashes
description: The White Lotus roots reach into your heart, while you reach your arms out towards the world. Slowly but surely, you inch towards the pinnacle of existence. Being everywhere, and nowhere - Formless.

name: White Stalker's Wings
description: Even Dracolich's feel the cold during Frostval, so that makes their wings perfect for the White Stalkers!

name: White Tiger Cape
description: A cape made of thick white fur. Spears and blades will never draw your blood…for the most part. White Tigers have a tendency to stand there and laugh about being untouchable, until their opponent finds a sweet spot.

name: White Tiger Fur Cape
description: The white tiger has long been recognized as the true "king of the beasts." He is most honorable and worthy of your worship. If you serve him with a pure heart and absolute virtue, you will be rewarded.

name: WhiteTiger's Spirit Tail
description: You possess a rare power - the ability to summon and control a White Tiger Shikigami! It will serve you loyaly as long as your intent is honorable and your heart pure.

name: Whoops! Cape

name: Wicked Chaooze Mutation

name: Wicked Edge Cape
description: Takes being stabbed in the back to a literal level.

name: Wicked Winglets
description: They have the potential to be bigger but these wings are purposely party sized.

name: Wicked Wings of Light
description: Light it up!

name: Wight's Crawling Darkness Cloak (0 AC)
description: The spirits of earth and moonlight mingled in darkness, and life crawled out of the shadows. So the Unhallowed Wights emerged from nothing, so they will return to nothing for rest.

name: Wight's Crawling Darkness Cloak (AC)
description: The spirits of earth and moonlight mingled in darkness, and life crawled out of the shadows. So the Unhallowed Wights emerged from nothing, so they will return to nothing for rest.

name: Wind Elemental Cape
description: You buffet your enemies with swift blows, like the wind.

description: Fur trimmed brushed wool cloak to keep the biting northern wind and snow at bay.

name: Wind Orb
description: Harness the power of the element of Wind! Equipping this orb makes you deal extra damage to Chaos and Elemental monsters AND gives you extra Gold when equipped! Merge it with the other 7 elemental orbs to create the Ultra Elemental Warrior Class!

name: Windblown Cape
description: This windblown scarf flaps cheerily in the strong Northlands breeze.

name: Windtorn Wrap
description: The enchanted ice built onto this armor helps keep the cold of the Northlands at bay.

name: WindWalker's Parang Cape
description: The WindWalkers are a sect of Warrior-Mages that defend and protect the people of Nusantara. They are sworn to serve Garuda the Bird King, and will do anything to keep their home safe.

name: WindWalker's Wings
description: The WindWalkers are a sect of Warrior-Mages that defend and protect the people of Nusantara. They are sworn to serve Garuda the Bird King, and will do anything to keep their home safe.

name: Windwhipped Scarf
description: The enchanted ice built onto this armor helps keep the cold of the Northlands at bay.

name: Winged Bloodmoon Cape
description: The moon drenched in blood, splattered and stained by the carnage you've wrought.

name: Winged Brightfall Cloak (0 AC)
description: In the name of Empress Gravelyn the Good, defend your home from ANY forces that would threaten your realm.

name: Winged Brightfall Cloak (AC)
description: In the name of Empress Gravelyn the Good, defend your home from ANY forces that would threaten your realm.

name: Winged Cloak of Enduring Light
description: Where there is a will, there is a way. Maglor the Lord of Exalted Light does everything in his power to help heroes find their own courage. Relying on his Light alone will cause them to lose the ability to brave despair without him.

name: Winged Eyes of the Void
description: With wings with which to see…with eyes with which to fly…

name: Winged Ink Heart
description: Give me all your hopeless hearts and make me ill. You're running after something that you'll never kill. If this is what you want, then fire at will.

name: Winged Midnight Fiend Cape
description: The style could fool vampires into thinking you're one of them. That would be a mistake, and the blood suckers would realize the darkness under your cape is moving on its own.

name: Winged Stinger
description: With the wings and the venomous stinger of the manticore, you will become an unstoppable force.

name: Winged Wrath Void Cape
description: It's a flap of extra skin that split off the main body during the mutation period inside the Fiend's Void. Eventually, they'll break in half and become giant wings.

name: Wings of a Zombie
description: Did you ever know that you're my enemy, and everything I would like to kill? I can cut the head off of a demon, 'cause you are the zombie beneath my wings.

name: Wings Of Abezeth
description: These are not as tainted but still their purity is long since diminished.

name: Wings of Arcadia
description: Delicate swan wings awarded to contestants who prove themselves in tourneys celebrating Heroes Heart Day. Most aren't aware that the feathers fuse to their backs. There's no escaping it, much like love!

name: Wings of Azalith
description: You can feel the dark power pulsing off these wings. They are a testament to your victory in the Infernal Arena.

name: Wings Of Ciriatto
description: Strong, sharp and vicious, these wings will carry you anywhere.

name: Wings of Courage
description: Celebrate the hero you were born to be.

name: Wings of Dark Sorrow
description: Beware the sky as your are not safe on the ground.

name: Wings of Darkness (1)
description: The loyal followers of the Shadowscythe earn these shadow wings.

name: Wings of Darkness (2)
description: The edges of these wings are razor sharp, cutting through anything that gets in the way.

name: Wings of Dawn
description: Let it soar! Let it soar! Can't hold you back anymore!

name: Wings Of Destruction
description: Embrace the shadows but beware… the light of the celestial realm can harm you!

name: Wings of Dusk
description: Crimson wings and a midnight cape suit the Vampire Knight well.

name: Wings of Enduring Life
description: Where there is a will, there is a way. Maglor the Lord of Exalted Light does everything in his power to help heroes find their own courage. Relying on his Light alone will cause them to lose the ability to brave despair without him.

name: Wings of Envy
description: What is a dragon hunter without some token of his or her prowess? Take what you want, leave nothing to waste. Make others envious of your might by donning these magnificent wings. The dead don't need them anyway, right?

name: Wings of Eternal Retribution
description: By the power of blood, breath, and bone, these dark magic users seek the ultimate prize: immortality… and they do not care who they must hurt to achieve it.

name: Wings Of Faith
description: Faith in yourself, or your friends and comrades, shall be your wings this day. May it take you higher than you've ever been.

name: Wings of First Light
description: The feathers glow with soft sunlight, warm as a first promise. Remember. A promise is only as important as the person you made it for.

name: Wings of Granite
description: Just the bare bones of a cape from a Earth Dragon.

name: Wings Of Holiness
description: Divine color-customed wings, ready to match any look.

name: Wings of Honor
description: Celebrate the hero you were born to be.

name: Wings Of Hope (AC)
description: Looking at these, perhaps hope truly is a thing with feathers.

name: Wings Of Hope (Legend)
description: Looking at these, perhaps hope truly is a thing with feathers.

name: Wings of Ice Wrap (0 AC)
